You don’t need a flashy CV or a perfectly memorized story. An updated LinkedIn profile is plenty. Come as you are. Tell us what excites you. What you’ve learned. Where you want to grow. You deserve to walk away with insight. That is why we offer thoughtful and actionable feedback, whether or not we extend an offer. We believe feedback fuels growth. That starts here. Wondering if you can use AI when applying? At Thoughtworks, we believe in the power of technology when it is used thoughtfully and responsibly. Our AI policy reflects this belief. Read the policy Tips from our recruiters Tips to improve your job search Avoid common mistakes and take small steps that make a big difference. Make your job search more effective Three simple ways to improve your chances of getting noticed. How to stand out as a candidate From your skills to your community work, we want to see the full picture. Inside the cultural interview More than an interview, it’s a conversation about who you are and what drives you. How to make a great impression at Thoughtworks Finding the right role or the right candidate can feel like a bit of a journey. At Thoughtworks, our recruiters want to help make that experience a little easier and a lot more human. They’ve put together their favorite tips to help candidates stand out, along with a few things to avoid along the way. From sending a thoughtful thank-you note to doing a bit of homework on who we are, these small touches can go a long way. Whether you’re just starting your job search or getting ready for an interview, we hope this guide helps you feel more prepared and confident. Start reading What candidates are saying about our interviews Curious about what it's like to go through the interview process at Thoughtworks? Our Glassdoor interview reviews offer real stories and insights from candidates: honest, unfiltered and in their own words. Read interview reviews on Glassdoor Stay connected Access Thoughtworks careers Looking for the latest news and updates on Thoughtworks as you navigate the next steps in your career journey? Sign up for our newsletter. Each month we’ll send you quick highlights on Thoughtworks careers, tech content, events and other insights on how Thoughtworkers are extraordinary, together. Subscribe now Frequently Asked Questions What happens after I submit my application? After you submit your application, it enters our applicant tracking system. Our Talent Acquisition team will review it against the job requirements. If there’s a strong match, a recruiter will contact you for an initial screening. If your profile isn’t selected for the current role, it may still be considered for future opportunities. How long does the typical recruiting process take from application to offer? We strive for efficiency, but the process duration can vary depending on the role’s complexity, the number of applicants and interview team availability. On average, it takes four to six weeks, though some specialized roles may take longer. We appreciate your patience and will keep you informed throughout the process. Are interviews onsite or remote? Most of our interviews are conducted remotely. However, in some cases, part of the interview process may take place onsite. Am I allowed to use AI? At Thoughtworks, we embrace the transformative potential of AI and encourage its responsible use in your application. We prioritize transparency and ask you to disclose any GenAI tool usage, as we value your unique skills, original work and authentic contributions. During assessments and interviews, we appreciate thoughtful use of AI tools and expect your responses to reflect your real-time skills and critical evaluation of AI-generated outputs. Here's our policy on the use of AI in recruitment. What should I do to prepare for an interview at Thoughtworks? Our interview coordinators will send you preparation materials in advance — be sure to read the guidelines carefully and prepare accordingly. Don’t worry, we won’t ask too much of you before each interview. Here are some general tips: - Research the company: Understand our mission, values, recent news and services. - Understand the role: Review the job description and think about how your skills fit. - Prepare questions: Have thoughtful questions ready for your interviewers. - Practice technical skills: If applying for a technical role, review relevant concepts and coding. - Use the STAR method: Prepare examples of how you’ve handled situations, tasks, actions and results. - Test your technology: For virtual interviews, check your internet, camera and microphone. What kind of questions can I expect during the interviews? In our technical interviews, we aim to simulate real situations you might encounter as a Thoughtworks employee. We also focus on our values and culture — especially collaboration, continuous learning and driving positive social change. What are the key stages of your hiring process? Our process typically includes four main stages. However, the structure may vary depending on the specific needs of our clients and the role you are applying for. We aim to follow these core internal steps whenever possible: Recruiter screen: An initial conversation about your background, interests and basic qualifications. Pairing interview: May include coding challenges, system design or architectural discussions. Case study or presentation: For roles that involve problem-solving or explaining complex ideas. Cultural and leadership interview: Focused on behavior, communication and soft skills. Are there any specific skills or experiences you always look for in candidates? Beyond role-specific technical skills, we value candidates who demonstrate a strong problem-solving mindset, adaptability, excellent communication (both technical and non-technical), a collaborative spirit, passion for technology and innovation, and a commitment to continuous learning. Experience in global, matrixed organizations is a plus for many roles. We also value technical certifications such as AWS, Cloud, Azure, Databricks and others. Do you consider international candidates and what are the visa sponsorship policies? Yes — we are a global company and frequently consider international candidates. Visa sponsorship policies vary by country, role and local immigration laws. If a role is open to international candidates and requires sponsorship, this will typically be discussed during the initial recruiter screen. We aim to support talented individuals who align with our global needs. How should I follow up after an interview? It’s a good idea to send a brief thank-you email within 24 hours, expressing your appreciation and reiterating your interest in the role. If you haven’t heard back within the timeline shared during the interview, you can politely follow up with your recruiter or point of contact. Are there any accommodations available for candidates with disabilities during the recruiting process? Yes — we are fully committed to providing reasonable accommodations to ensure an equitable and accessible recruiting experience. Please notify your recruiter as early as possible if you require any accommodations during the application, interview or assessment stages. All requests will be handled confidentially. How does your recruiting process ensure fairness and equal opportunity? At Thoughtworks, we’re committed to creating a truly inclusive environment for everyone — regardless of age, ethnicity, gender, orientation, religion, ability, background or identity. This commitment begins with our recruitment process and continues throughout your career journey with us. Learn more about our approach to diversity and inclusion . To ensure fairness and equal opportunity, we: - Follow a standardized interview process with consistent evaluation criteria for all candidates. - Use diverse interview panels to help minimize unconscious bias. - Provide unconscious bias training to our recruiters and interviewers. - Make hiring decisions based on objective, skills-based assessments and data. - Use inclusive language in job descriptions. - Ensure our application process is accessible to candidates with disabilities. All of this reflects our dedication to empowering every individual and building a workplace where everyone can thrive. I don't see a relevant open role, can I still apply? You can still stay connected with us. Subscribe to our monthly careers newsletter and choose to receive career-related notifications about future opportunities. Can I apply for multiple positions? Yes — you’re welcome to apply for multiple roles that match your skills and experience. Please focus on roles that are truly relevant to your background. Our recruiters review applications across various roles, so applying to too many unrelated positions may not be beneficial. Can I update my application or resume after submitting it? Currently, once an application is submitted, it cannot be edited. However, you can reapply with an updated resume. Will I be informed if I’m not selected? Yes — our recruiters are committed to informing all candidates of the outcome of their interview process. The further you progress, the more detailed feedback we’ll be able to provide. Do I need a degree to apply? While some roles may list educational qualifications, we believe talent comes from diverse backgrounds. We do not seek an "elite" profile — we highly value equivalent experience and transferable skills, and we actively encourage applications from career changers. Please check each job description for specific requirements, but know that we value potential and passion as much as traditional qualifications. Financial benefits​ Our financial benefits are designed to recognize individual performance, support career progression, and encourage long-term development. Employees benefit from semiannual bonus payments, quarterly promotion cycles, and an annual salary review, ensuring compensation remains aligned with performance, evolving roles, and market standards. These practices reflect our commitment to transparency, recognition, and continuous growth. Leave benefits​ We support work-life balance through a clear annual leave policy, enabling employees to rest, recharge, and manage personal needs. In Brazil, as a certified Empresa Cidadã, we offer extended maternity leave (180 days) and paternity leave (20 days), reinforcing our commitment to supporting families and employees during important life moments. Health and wellness benefits​ Our health and wellness benefits support employees’ physical and emotional well-being through medical and dental coverage, life insurance, and access to an Employee Assistance Program (EAP) that provides confidential support. We also encourage daily well-being through workplace exercise (Labor Gym) sessions—available both onsite and online, quick massage services at the office, and monthly workshops and webinars with health partners focused on mental health, healthy habits, and quality of life. A leading applied technology services company, Mphasis has sprinted exciting laps of transformation to stand tall on the edge of NEXT and positive disruption. As a testing professional, you get ample opportunities to work with various powerful tools and domain specific applications/engagements using some of the latest technologies. At Mphasis, Testing is the gateway to the customer delivery ensuring customer expectations, zero defect escapes and maintaining code quality as utmost priority throughout the testing life cycle. You will have an opportunity to work with latest methodologies and process like Shift Left Methodology, In-Sprint Testing, DevOps/ CI/CD, ATDD, BDD, TDD, MDD and you will be expose to the various such environments wherein your career growth will be benefitted. Training and certification programs at Mphasis enable you to choose the areas of your interest in the testing space. Software testing professionals at Mphasis are a talented bunch of highly motivated peers you will be excited to work with. Explore NextGen Automation testing jobs, performance engineering testing jobs, API and microservices testing jobs, Security testing job, Mobile and cloud apps testing jobs at Mphasis. WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR ? NextGen Automation Testing Deep understanding of layered automation architecture and wide experience in application domains & ecosystems that are built on different technologies (.Net, Java/J2EE, PHP, Python etc.) Capability to define the advance testing processes, procedures, testing strategy and gear automation development as a SDET functions Automation experience in COTS products and packaged applications (SFDC, ERP/CRM, SAP etc.) & ability to quickly adopt to changing trends/landscapes. Ability to Plan, Design, Build, Implement and Deploy unified cost-effective test automation frameworks to support all kinds of testing, standardize and improve regression test automation processes and frameworks Understand different development and testing methodologies (Waterfall, Agile, Shift-left, CI/CD, ATDD, BDD, TDD, MDD etc.) Proficiency in test estimation, automation requirement analysis, test design approaches and being able to implement an agnostic framework end to end for (Web UI, Desktop Apps, API, Microservices & Mobile Apps etc.) Thorough experience in leading industry standards of automation testing using various tools like Micro Focus-UFT, IBM-RFT, Test Complete, PARASOFT, SOAPUI, Tosca, Selenium, BDD Cucumber, Appium, RANORAX etc. Capability to deep dive, perform deep analysis of automation test results, setup standard test automation metrics/KPIs, able to establish standardization in automation testing and optimize automation efforts Capable of deriving automation engineering roadmap at program/engagement level Performance Engineering Thorough architecture level understanding of applications built on different technologies (.Net, J2EE etc.) and COTS products & quick adoption to changing trends/landscapes. Understand different software development methodologies & automation around it (Waterfall, Agile, shift-left, CI/CD, BDD etc.) Proficiency in estimates, performance requirement analysis, design approaches and nimbly move to alternate approaches (if needed) develop and execute tests. Thorough experience in leading & industry standard performance testing (LoadRunner/JMeter/Gatling/Neoload/BlazeMeter etc.) and APM (AppDynamics, Dynatrace, NewRelic etc.) tools Capable of deep dive analysis of performance test results & recommend and lead tuning efforts. Capability to derive performance engineering roadmap at program/engagement level. API and Micro Services Testing Deep understanding of SOA web services architecture, microservices architecture and extensive experience in middleware services, messaging layer & backend database ecosystems that built on different or common technologies i.e. (.Net, Java/J2EE, PHP, Python etc.) Strong Experience in REST APIs, SOAP Web Services and Microservices testing and automation various using tools like SOAPUI, Postman, Tricentis Tosca, Karate DSL, Rest-Assured etc. Robust ability to design, build, implement and deploy Microservices test automation framework on various cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, GCP connected with Apigee, MuleSoft and WSO2 etc. API management platforms and DevOps platform. Capable to automate the web services using open-source and commercial tools, able to understand the enterprise business service layer and translate into API functional test cases. API / Microservices automation experience with packaged applications SFDC, ERP/CRM, SAP etc. exposed web services for internal App integration and faster adoption to changing trends/landscapes. Proficiency in API test estimation, automation requirement analysis, test design approaches and able to implement API frameworks. Capable to deep dive, perform deep analysis of API automation test results, Setup standard for API test automation metrics/KPIs, able to establish standardization in API automation testing and optimize automation efforts. Expertise in security testing, able to plan, design and implement robust security testing framework using tools like Vega, Burp suite, Zed attack Proxy, OWASP, Wapiti, SQLMap, and static code analyzer tools like HP Fortify tec. Strong Experience in application security testing approaches, tools and techniques and able to build the robust compliance for Application software and products. Robust ability to design, build, implement and deploy security test automation Framework on various cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, GCP connected with Apigee, MuleSoft and WSO2 etc. API management platforms and DevOps platform. Capable to understand the client requirements, discover and implement the testing for security, safety and privacy in a single framework and able to assess the enterprise business application risks and translate into security test scenarios / test cases. Security testing experience with packaged applications SFDC, ERP/CRM, SAP etc., vulnerability analysis for service integration layers and generate penetration testing reports. Capable to deep dive, perform deep analysis of security automation test results, security test metrics/KPIs, able to establish standardization in security testing across applications. Ability to derive security engineering roadmap at program/engagement level. Ability to design, build, implement and deploy Mobile/cloud test automation Framework on various cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, GCP connected IoT smart Devices and DevOps platform. Capable to understand the client requirements, discover and implement the Social code testing, cloud migration testing, data analytics, mobile apps testing, browser compatibility testing , interoperability testing, latency testing, fail-over testing, scalability testing and browser performance testing etc. in one framework for Cloud automation services and able to assess the enterprise business digital transformation and translate into Mobile and cloud testing use cases. Cloud testing experience with packaged applications like SFDC, ERP/CRM, SAP etc. quick adoption to changing trends/landscapes/ demand and delivering tests Capable to deep dive, perform deep analysis of mobile and cloud automation, test metrics/KPIs, able to establish standardization in mobile and cloud testing across applications and products. Ability to derive mobile and cloud engineering roadmap at program/engagement level. ALL ABOUT SOFTWARE TESTING JOB YOU NEED TO KNOW [+] How testing at Mphasis is made relevant in today’s accelerated software development process? What is NextGen test automation at Mphasis? Answer to this question addresses that the testing is not only here to stay, but is integral to any business going through the inevitable “Digital Transformation”. Testing is all about how the tools and technologies are evolving. Mphasis is an early bird to address the market solutions in the testing and quality space by understanding that the acceleration of time-to-market is the continues process and is a must within the software practice. Currently Agile-DevOps have occupied the center stage for the software development process and it is becoming very important to assure higher quality to the applications. Mphasis NextGen test automation is equipped with frameworks at every level of business and test automation requirements to achieve customer goals in the era of CI, CD and CT. [+] What is the Mphasis’s mantra to achieve utmost quality in codes? Agile-DevOps has created a platform for development, testing and deployment teams with product owner and brought all stakeholders on the same discussion table. Going forward Agile-DevOps will be the defacto standard; this next generation automation and IP led accelerators will drive the testing transformation across the industries. At Mphasis we have accelerators from API testing till performance reporting with inbuilt intuitive dashboards. The accelerators include the scope of test automation, scalability of the approach, extent of reusability, and more importantly the metrics to measure the success of test automation. [+] What is the approach Mphasis is practicing in NextGen testing capability and how the success is measured? Effectiveness of testing is a critical aspect of keeping up with the faster life cycles of development. By considering the implementation of agile and DevOps adoption. Mphasis invested in test automation accelerators to meet different project needs. The view of Mphasis is simple - implement state-of- the-art testing techniques and pass benefits to customers in terms of substantial savings and a competitive edge. Mphasis is focusing on optimizing testing and related deployment operations with its expertise in testing insight so that more resources remain available for innovation with a careful balance between speed and quality, regardless of the industry or technology involved. The Practical Test Pyramid adopted by Mphasis is a common method for implementing a testing strategy. 1. We conduct unit tests on a smaller runtime Environment (such as using Docker image), to isolate them to a single change that would help build consistent deployments of pipelines. 2. Integration tests can be carried out to determine whether connectivity with other services works and that the results will be handled and remain valid for the requirements. 3. While UI tests cover a lot of usability tests, rigorous end-to-end testing that looks at user ' travels ' through the application should be done Within the sprint, testers will automate user stories with n-1 approach alongside development by automating unit tests, API tests and part of the UI tests, but only leaving the UI mapping. Definition of Done is important to a highly functioning Scrum team as it lists the tasks that the team needs to perform before an improvement in the product. These activities include programming, test data creation, testing / integration testing / retesting, documentation, etc. Verifying that the Done definition of project team meets these criteria will make sure us try to deliver quality software with all the important features. Mphasis offers its well-established experience by applying the accelerators based on its due diligence consulting, with its proven case studies with consumer satisfaction. For overall effort reduction, the Mphasis published the metrics were 35 percent to 42 percent. The desire for "quality at speed" is the primary importance of the viewpoint and strategy of Mphasis automation, with accelerators being developed in-house and some being implemented on premises, and both having to work together seamlessly when deployed. [+] What training is available for testing professionals at Mphasis Mphasis has an extensive global training facility. This comprises of online tutorials, virtual classroom-based training and also local specialized training delivered through external technical specialists. The objective of the testing training is to develop and improve professional skills and assist employees reach their career potential. Each testing role in the organization has an identified list of courses to be completed. Every employee will complete 40 hours of mandatory role-based training covering process, tools, software testing and behavioral training. Every employee develops an annual Individual Development Plan (IDP) in conjunction with their line manager. In addition to this, specific trainings are organized based on the IDP’s/project needs/organizational needs. This enables training to be targeted not only to allow each employee to reach their career goals but also to meet the future testing needs of the business. Categories of Training Process – Enterprise Testing Method (all levels) Test management Software testing and certifications Tools – Quality Center, Quick Test Professional, LoadRunner and other project specific tools Industry specific training Soft skills/behavioral training [+] What qualification and skills are required to be employed as Performance Engineer? Application Architecture level understanding Understand the performance requirements with help of BA/stakeholders to create performance test plan/ Strategy. Experience on Performance testing tool - Load Runner/JMeter etc. Creation and Execution of test scripts and reporting results for website and web, API/Web Service based applications Resolving complex performance scripting issues Experience with testing microservices, mobile and cloud-based application. Strong Windows, Unix & Linux skills, ability to write shell scripts for information gathering purposes Configure and monitor APM tools like AppDynamics, Dynatrace, NewRelic etc. Sound understanding of Application architecture, JVM tuning, GC, Thread Dump Analysis. Monitoring of various server resources like DB connection pools, Threads, JMS queues/topics/modules etc. Good understanding of DB Architecture. SQL, PL/SQL, Performance Stats, familiarity DB like PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle and Casandra etc. Good understanding of Load Balancers like F5 – LB methods, Virtual servers, Virtual Pools, Rules, Connection & Cookie persistence. Familiarity with information security - encryptions, SSL/ TSL etc. [+] What are Micro services? Microservice architecture - is an architectural style that structures an application as a collection of services that are highly maintainable, scalable and testable. Loosely coupled. Independently deployable. [+] Why do we need to test and automate microservices? Tests can in turn be used to check the service-to-service communication, test communication paths, and tests micro services independent functions, fix potential services issues before delivery and speed/quality of service. Expertise in API/Microservices, SOA Architecture level understanding, and SOAP and REST APIs Understand the web services requirements with help of BA/stakeholders to create API test plan / Strategy. Strong Windows, Unix & Linux skills, ability to write shell scripts for information gathering purposes. Good in API-driven integration for GIT/ALM/CI-CT integration using REST APIs connectors etc. Good understanding of DB Architecture. SQL/NoSQL DBs, familiarity DB like PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle, MongoDB and Casandra etc. Good understanding of AngularUI, REST/JSON, Spring boot, Java Spring Microservices and Spring Framework. Familiarity with information security tools – Cryptography, RSA/encryptions, OAuth2.0, SSL/ TSL etc. [+] What is App Security Testing? Security testing helps to Simulate an attack while web applications are running to identify vulnerabilities without the need for source code and determine real-world early threats and risks to your organization. [+] Why do we need to test and automate Security Apps? • Security Testing is to identify the threats in the system and measure its potential vulnerabilities, so the threats can be encountered, and the system does not stop functioning or cannot be exploited. Actively participate in establishing security testing plans, estimating work, and monitoring progress against milestones. Make recommendations to improve product security and quality assurance best practices and processes. Strong Windows, Unix & Linux skills, ability to write shell scripts for information gathering purposes. Case studies Community work Frequently asked questions Careers at PwC India What career opportunities are available at PwC India? PwC India offers roles across consulting, risk, ESG, deals, and technology. Opportunities are available for students, fresh graduates, and experienced professionals across multiple industries and functions. What makes PwC India a good place to work? PwC India combines meaningful work, continuous learning, and a collaborative culture. Employees work on real-world challenges, develop future-ready skills, and grow within a diverse and inclusive global network. What types of roles are available for freshers? Freshers can apply to entry-level roles in consulting, operations, analytics, technology, and support functions. Campus hiring programmes also provide structured learning and early career development opportunities. Application and hiring process How can I apply for a job at PwC India? You can apply through the PwC India careers portal by searching for relevant roles, submitting your application online, and completing the recruitment process, which may include assessments and interviews. What is the PwC India hiring process? The hiring process typically includes application screening, assessments (if required), and multiple interview rounds. The process is designed to evaluate your skills, experience, and alignment with PwC’s values. Can I apply for multiple roles at PwC India? Yes, you can apply for multiple roles that match your skills and interests. However, it is recommended to apply for roles where your profile aligns closely with the job requirements. Skills & Qualifications What skills does PwC India look for in candidates? PwC looks for problem-solving ability, collaboration, communication skills, and integrity. Technical expertise relevant to the role, along with adaptability and a willingness to learn, are also important. Work environment and culture What is the work culture like at PwC India? PwC India promotes a collaborative and inclusive culture where employees are encouraged to bring their authentic selves to work. The organisation focuses on teamwork, innovation, and continuous development. Does PwC India offer flexible or remote work options? PwC offers flexible work arrangements depending on the role and business requirements. This may include hybrid work models and policies that support employee wellbeing. How does PwC support employee wellbeing? PwC provides wellbeing initiatives, benefits, and support programmes that focus on physical, mental, and financial health, helping employees maintain a balanced and productive work life. Learning and growth What learning and development opportunities does PwC provide? PwC offers structured learning programmes, on-the-job experience, mentorship, and leadership development. Employees can continuously upgrade their skills through training and real-world project exposure. What is the PwC professional framework? The PwC Professional framework is a global development model that defines the skills and behaviours expected from employees. It guides career growth through leadership, technical expertise, and collaboration. Can I grow my career internationally with PwC? Yes, PwC provides opportunities to work with global teams and gain international exposure through cross-border projects and collaboration within its global network. Is there a fee to apply for jobs at PwC India? No, PwC does not charge any fee for job applications. Candidates should apply only through official PwC websites and verified channels. To achieve this and more, we are strengthening our community of solvers and building a knowledge powerhouse. We are bringing together talented individuals from varied backgrounds and with differentiated skill sets to create value-driven solutions. We invite you to join us on this exciting journey to make a lasting difference and usher in a better tomorrow. Asha Ramanathan Chief Operating Officer, PwC India At PwC, our community of solvers come together in diverse ways to deliver on our purpose – to build trust and solve important problems. Our refreshed strategy, The New Equation, equips us to leverage our 150-year old legacy and build impactful human-led and tech-powered solutions which deliver sustained outcomes for our clients. Our people are at the heart of our organisation, bound together by our collective purpose and values. We at PwC thrive on a culture that fosters inclusion, focuses on learning that builds fit-for-future capabilities and is committed to the wellbeing of our people – truly making it a ‘Great Place to Work’. If solving complex problems through a human-led and tech-powered approach excites you, then having you excites us. Arnab Basu Advisory Leader, PwC India Hello everyone, Welcome to the new page for campus careers. With the launch of our New Equation strategy last year, we shared our aspiration to attract the best talent in the market and be the choice of employer for most of you. This aspiration is built on our strong culture that has shaped many careers in the last 150 years in India. Now, with over 12,000 multi-skilled people within the Advisory practice and our constant endeavours to upskill and make our people future ready, I’m confident that the career opportunities we offer are among the best in the industry today. Like most of you, I too joined PwC through a campus recruitment programme more than two decades ago. It has been a remarkable journey since then, with immense learning across the years and opportunities to work in the US and Europe through our global secondment programme. I look forward to engaging and interacting with all of you – our new community of solvers – to deliver transformational solutions to our clients together! Our campus hiring and engagement programmes provide opportunities for students to learn more about PwC India’s culture, people, values and business. While being a part of a campus programme you can leverage your unique strengths and make an impact that matters. These programs are an excellent way to engage and learn from our business leaders. Mansi Gandhi National Institute of Technology, Warangal, One Consulting Announcements Our Business Areas Accounting Advisory Advisory/Consulting Deals Risk Assurance Internal Firm Services Business faces myriad complex accounting issues related to acquisitions, consolidations, debt and equity offerings, restatements, GAAP conversion, treasury, hedging and more. These are major challenges and may disrupt day-to-day operations. We help companies maximise value during these moments of exceptional change. With a global network of trusted advisors, we support companies with their accounting, financial reporting and valuation needs. Our practitioners combine accounting, valuation and tax expertise to help preserve the value of business. We tailor solutions to the needs, allowing for a thorough approach in anticipation of the requirements of auditors, investors and regulators. Our Services: Transactions & Events GAAP Transformation Accounting Advisory Support Capital Markets The future is for those who think beyond the boundaries of today and uncover the new sources of value. We help organizations work smarter and grow faster. Businesses reach out to us to build effective organizations, reduce costs, manage risk and regulation and leverage talent. Our formula is simple: we deliver bold ideas, empowering technology and meaningful experiences creating real-life results. This is our new value equation and we help solve for a better tomorrow. Our Services: Management Consulting- We are committed to delivering value to our clients and ensuring long-term success.Businesses reach out to us to improve their performance, innovate and grow, reduce costs, leverage talent and transform their organization. Technology Consulting - As business integrators, we work on transformational engagements, helping our clients solve complex business problems using technology as an enabler. Risk Consulting- We help clients navigate the complexity of unforeseen events and help manage risks. Businesses reach out to us to manage their cybersecurity programmes, financial and market risks, crisis events, fraud investigations, Impact of regulatory changes and provide insights to management and boards. Analysing strategic options, divesting a business unit, integrating two companies: each phase of a deal presents specific issues and challenges. We have the right people with the right expertise who can advise and assist with each phase. We help businesses make the right decisions to maximize their value of deals. Our Services: Deals Strategy Corporate Finance & Investment Banking Transaction Services Business Recovery Services Valuation Delivering Deal Value Today’s business and risk landscape presents both great challenges and opportunities. PwC’s Risk Assurance professionals combine deep cross-functional expertise and leading technologies to improve visibility into risks, respond with agility and drive greater preparedness for the future. We bring together specialist disciplines and commercial expertise to give the insight, foresight and independent advice needed to build and safeguard the value of all parts of business. We transform the way businesses perceive - and navigate - risks, so they can stay at the forefront of change. Our Services: Internal Audit- PwC's Internal Audit Services (IAS) practice offers a tailored mix of resources, tools and insights to clients who seek to enhance their internal audit functions. Governance, Risk & Compliance- In an increasingly complex and volatile business environment, companies cannot afford to be non-compliant with regulations or ignore uncertainties. The rapidly changing business environment requires companies to innovate risk strategies. IT & Project Assurance- The digital age is here. IT systems are a fundamental part of all organisations and businesses - along with their customers, shareholders and regulators - need to trust it to rely on it. The IT and Project Assurance practice can enable businesses to embrace new technologies and opportunities which would be crucial to stay competitive. Financial Services- The world of risk is changing. Challenging economic times, volatile world events and ever-changing technology are rendering organizations more vulnerable than ever before. It is becoming increasingly hard to predict where new risks would come from. PwC’s Financial Services practice can enable businesses to navigate through periods of uncertainty and enhanced regulations. Internal Firm Services leverages its impact and our professionals know how to create an agreeable environment for everyone at the firm. Inclusion and Diversity Inclusion, Diversity and Belonging at PwC --> To solve important problems we need to be inclusive of our diverse talents and use the power of our differences to achieve our goals. At PwC India, we are committed to fostering a culture that allows our people to be their authentic self, feel equitably supported in their careers and ensure they genuinely belong at PwC. Diverse and inclusive teams are innovative, bringing in a broad range of perspectives and ideas. Building trust and solving important problems is only possible if PwC India reflects the mosaic of the society we live in. --> Download the report --> (PDF, 1.7mb) --> International Women’s Day 2024 This International Women’s Day , we are looking beyond diversity – to emphasise how much #InclusionMatters to the experiences and outcomes of women at work. A workplace where women feel that they belong, are included in decision-making, and are treated fairly, equitably and with respect, is a workplace where women thrive. Inclusion at work is a catalyst for women’s growth and advancement in every sector, and positions them more strongly to respond to key workforce developments. We are committed to accelerating progress on this by valuing the voices of women and adopting a strategic approach that emphasises inclusion. Together, we are building an inclusive future . Inclusion networks Serving as a community to foster inclusivity and drive positive change At PwC India, we are committed to fostering a culture that allows our people to be their authentic self, feel equitably supported in their careers and ensure they genuinely belong at PwC. Our drivers for change PwC’s purpose is to build trust in society and solve important problems and extend their Inclusion focus to the external context in which they operate to positively impact social inclusion and be an accelerator for change both within and beyond PwC. To deliver this we focus on 5 global drivers for change; namely 5 critical areas of central focus to foster network direction and support. Inclusion for all Gender LGBTQ+ Persons with disabilities Next generation Inclusion for all At PwC, Inclusion for All is how we unlock the power and potential of our people. When we bring together different perspectives, experiences and skills, we are stronger – for each other, for our clients, and for the communities we serve. Inclusion for All is about creating a culture where everyone feels they belong and can do their best work. It goes beyond intent and becomes part of how we think, act and lead every day – in our teams, in our interactions, and in the systems that shape our experiences at PwC. Our approach focuses on embedding inclusion into the fabric of our firm – influencing behaviours, strengthening skills, and designing processes that work for everyone. By doing this consistently and intentionally, we create an environment where individuality is valued, diverse strengths are recognised, and our people can thrive across every stage of their PwC journey. Read more Gender Gender equality is at the forefront of our mission. We're committed to breaking down barriers and creating opportunities for women to excel in their careers, ensuring that gender does not limit their potential. Read More LGBTQ+ We support a workplace where lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender and other (LGBTQ+) solvers can bring their best selves to work and feel the full support of their PwC family. To foster this environment, we are working to grow LGBTQ+ equality and accelerate change, within PwC and in the wider world. Read More Persons with disabilities We champion the abilities of all, regardless of physical or cognitive differences. Our commitment to disability inclusion means creating accessible workplaces and offering opportunities for individuals with disabilities to thrive. Read More Next generation Nurturing the next generation of talent is vital for our future. We're focused on empowering young professionals, providing them with the skills, mentorship, and opportunities needed to become leaders and change-makers in their fields. Sumit Makhija Partner - Forensic Services, PwC India --> Careers Check out opportunities and start your career at PwC India View Opportunities Inclusion and Diversity at PwC Vision Mission Strategy To be a leading organisation for inclusion and belonging with our people, clients and external stakeholders, and a leading employee destination for diverse talent. An accelerator for Inclusion and Diversity change, both within and beyond PwC, recognised for our distinguished community of diverse and inclusive solvers who build trust and deliver sustained outcomes. Enabling The New Equation – we will achieve this by enhancing the breadth and depth of the diversity of our solvers and developing the human skills that will enable us to value diversity and think, act and lead inclusively. This will empower our community of solvers to come together in unexpected ways to build trust and deliver sustained outcomes while continuing to build a culture of belonging and equity for our community of solvers. Strategy enables The New Equation by embedding Inclusion and Diversity within the firm’s culture, while being an Inclusion and Diversity change accelerator both within PwC and the wider societies in which we operate. We will achieve this by holding our leaders accountable for inclusion and diversity, continuing to build a culture of inclusion, equity, belonging and transparency, and being an external voice for change. Inclusion Networks Shine Group Next Gen Forum Cross Culture Network PwC’s New Moms Shine Group Shine — an inclusive business network for our LGBTQ+ community - is all about breaking down barriers of difference and connecting people. Shine celebrates that we’re all unique, regardless of our sexuality, race, gender, religion or ability, and promotes an inclusive, diverse and respectful work environment. It works to strengthen our presence in the LGBTQ+ community as the distinctive firm and employer of choice and to identify business development opportunities in the community at large. Next Gen Forum The NextGen Forum is a community of high-performing associates, senior associates, and managers. They are diverse in gender, grade, ethnicity, LoS, background and regions. The forum gives members the golden opportunity to engage with and shape the firm’s business, clients, markets and Human Capital strategies and the decisions. Cross Culture Network CCN looks at problems from new angles to uncover solutions that deliver sustained outcomes & build trust in line with The New Equation. By bringing together combinations of skills, experience and technology, The vision is to design and deliver a development program that will enable our people to deepen their cultural awareness and become advocates for cross cultural diversity in their local firms PwC’s New Moms At PwC, we want to provide the necessary resources to help retain and support all our new moms. Our value of “care” encourages us to create a community of support and guidance, and PwC’s new moms is a support group to help them prepare for theirr return back to work and to make their transition successful. This is what our Employees have to say… Maternity comes with inherent challenges, which makes it difficult to deliver in the same manner as we would have otherwise. At such a time, the availing of policy benefits took the pressure off year-end outcomes. It was one less thing to worry about. I was able to focus on my health and work without stress. It was a feeling of someone having my back when I might not be at my best. To be honest, the policy is a boon for new mothers. Suruchi Nema Vellore Institute of Technology --> Going on maternity leave is a very unnerving time, personally as well as professionally. By availing the “retain your rating” policy, I am relaxed on the professional front that my career growth will not be hampered. Pooja Dalmia Vellore Institute of Technology --> I availed the "retain your rating policy" the year I took maternity leave. The leave was six months long, starting from August 2019 to February 2020. My pregnancy was during Covid lockdown time. The time was challenging enough for each of us to begin with; being in a physically difficult situation just added to the stress. Anonymous VIT VELLORE --> I opted for the “retain your rating” policy when I planned for my maternity leave in 2021. I got to know about the policy through my BUHC at the time of applying for maternity leave on Workday. I appreciate PwC for supporting working women to avail this benefit as it gives a sense of security. Anonymous Amrita School of Engineering, Bengaluru --> Why inclusion and diversity matters at PwC Values and Purpose driven Not only is a focus on Inclusion and Diversity the right thing to do , it also goes to the heart of our Values and Purpose. We can only solve the world’s most important problems with diverse teams and by fostering a culture of inclusion, trust and transparency (ESG), and we can only be viewed as purpose-led and values-driven by taking a visible stand on Inclusion and Diversity, and developing a leadership and workforce makeup that accurately reflects the societies in which we do business. Creativity, innovation and transformation Extensive research shows that the coming together of people of different backgrounds with different experiences is a key driver of creativity, collaboration and innovation.The impact of PwC’s business ambitions and the Future of Work mean it is simply critical that we have an agile, diverse and inclusive talent pool if we want to deliver on being a community of tech-enabled and human-led problem solvers who build trust and deliver sustained outcomes to our clients while also creating a culture of inclusion and belonging for our people. Business performance Substantial research shows that diversity brings many advantages to an organisation: increased profitability, stronger governance, better problem solving abilities, greater employee discretionary effort, and lower staff turnover. This combined with client and market expectations, namely the fact that we are seeing growing demand for global expertise combined with growing diversity expectations and engagement demands from our clients across the globe means we simply cannot afford to get this wrong. Employer of choice Today’s talent seek employers who are both committed to and representative of Inclusion and Diversity. To attract and retain top talent this is an absolute for PwC. Furthermore, companies with more diverse and inclusive teams are shown to be better at building leaders, foster greater team commitment and have talent who feel more empowered. Having diversity of experience, skill and thought will provide us with a competitive edge and position us as the most relevant and trusted professional services firm. Middle East and Africa Bahrain Visit career page Israel Visit career page Kuwait Visit career page Qatar Visit career page Saudi Arabia Visit career page South Africa Visit career page Republic of Korea Visit career page Singapore Visit career page Philippines Visit career page United Arab Emirates Visit career page Recognition and accolades Get a glimpse of possible career journeys at TCS through the eyes of our associates People of TCS Swipe Left Swipe Right Ritvik Shyam "TCS has given me the platform to grow, mentor young talent, and build purposeful networks." At TCS, I have had the opportunity to work at the intersection of AI, data, and business innovation, helping clients move from complex challenges to tangible outcomes. As Lead Data Scientist at TCS Pace Port™ London, I have collaborated with senior stakeholders, led discovery workshops, and contributed to rapid MVP development that brings ideas to life. What makes this journey especially meaningful is the people: working alongside talented, cross-functional teams and learning from mentors who continuously challenge and support me. Beyond client engagements, TCS has given me the platform to grow as an AI specialist, publish thought leadership content, mentor young talent, contribute to Corporate Social Responsibility initiatives, and build purposeful networks. It is an environment where I can turn cutting-edge AI capabilities into trusted, long-term value. Open in New Tab Eloise White "Every experience at TCS has broadened my skills, perspectives, and opportunities." At TCS, I have had the chance to grow through different roles while contributing to work that make a positive impact. I started as an intern with the Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) team, delivering our flagship STEM programme to inspire young people to consider careers in technology and supporting the HOPE volunteering programme across the UK. After 18 months, I transitioned to the UK Public Sector Pre-sales team, focusing on Social Value, where I contribute to bids that help create lasting benefits for clients and communities. Each step in my journey has built on the last, expanding my skills, confidence, and perspective. Supported by continuous learning opportunities and collaboration across the business, I have been able to develop both professionally and personally while exploring new paths for growth. Open in New Tab Uday Menon "At TCS, your next challenge may be just around the corner—be willing to take risks." TCS gave me the platform to explore different opportunities until I found my niche in account-based sales and customer relationships within the retail vertical. That journey included roles across consulting, pre-sales, product management, and program management, each helping me build new perspectives and capabilities. One lesson I have learned is the importance of not becoming too comfortable in a role that no longer challenges you. At TCS, the next opportunity may be just around the corner, but spotting it requires a strong internal network and a willingness to take risks. By staying open to new possibilities, learning from trusted colleagues, and supporting others in return, I have been able to continuously grow and evolve throughout my journey. Joyce Tollenaar "At TCS, I combine legal expertise and IT insights to create lasting value." What began as a role in contract management has evolved into a strategic responsibility where technology, law, governance, and human connection come together. Supporting the Public Sector across the Netherlands and Europe as Lead for Contract Management, I work within a complex landscape of regulations, IT, compliance requirements, and diverse stakeholder interests. Representing TCS within contractual frameworks, I focus on proactively managing risks, preventing escalations, and delivering sustainable solutions while building strong, trusted client relationships. By combining legal expertise with IT insight, I help create balanced agreements that minimise exposure and support long-term value creation. Working in a European and international environment allows me to contribute to cross-border impact, support TCS’ growth, and continuously strengthen my own skills in a dynamic, technology-driven landscape. Thomas Jonkman "From trainee to Commercial Lead, TCS has supported every step of my journey." I joined the Grow@TCS Trainee program in 2023 after graduating from university, and it gave me a strong foundation to begin my professional journey. The experience helped me transition into a Pricing Analyst role, where I worked on go-to-market analysis, pricing scenarios, and business case development for large deals. Today, as a Commercial Lead for Strategic and Large Deals, I contribute to deal structuring and price-to-win analysis for large-scale, multi-million-euro opportunities across Europe. Throughout this journey, TCS has consistently provided opportunities to showcase my skills, learn from experienced leaders, and take on new challenges. The mentorship, guidance, and support from my leaders, managers, and colleagues have played a key role in my development. I am grateful to be part of an organisation that encourages learning, empowers young talent, and provides exposure to impactful global business opportunities. Ruka Misawa "TCS Japan has empowered me to apply GenAI in meaningful ways across industries." At TCS Japan, I have been able to shape a career that brings together my PhD background in astrophysics, my passion for AI, and the opportunity to solve real business challenges. In my role as Deputy Head of the AI Centre of Excellence, TCS Japan has empowered me to lead consulting engagements end-to-end, from pre-sales to delivery, and to apply GenAI in meaningful ways across industries such as insurance, construction, pharmaceuticals, and manufacturing. Through TCS, I have grown from working in machine learning to specialising in generative AI, deploying solutions in the fields of RAG and process automation. I have also actively shared my knowledge by training engineers through the GenAI Dojo programme, lecturing at universities, and contributing to leading Japanese IT media. Recognition as an ML/AI SME and an invitation to an AWS certification workshop in Seattle have further strengthened my commitment to lifelong learning, collaboration, and responsible AI innovation. Learning and growth At TCS, growth begins with learning. We foster a culture of continuous development where associates are encouraged to expand their knowledge, pursue their ambitions, and build future-ready skills. From interactive learning and certifications to mentoring, leadership development, and real-world project experiences, our ecosystem supports continuous growth at every stage of an associate’s career. We empower our people to build the capabilities they need today while preparing for the opportunities of tomorrow. Health and well-being Health and well-being We believe in a holistic approach to well-being. Health and well-being We believe in a holistic approach to well-being, one that is fundamental to personal and professional success. At TCS, we support our associates through initiatives such as Fit4Life and TCS Cares. These programmes promote the physical, mental, emotional, and social wellness of our associates, thereby helping them thrive at work and in life, while fostering a strong sense of purpose. TCS' global marathon partnerships also champion health, inclusion, and community impact. With nearly 600,000 associates across 55 countries and 202 service delivery centres (as on June 30, 2026) representing multiple nationalities, cultures, backgrounds, and experiences, we are committed to building a workplace where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered to succeed. We foster a culture of inclusion and equal opportunity that encourages people to collaborate openly and contribute with confidence. Holistic well-being programs within TCS promote a healthier lifestyle, offer work-life balance, and take into account emotional health. Through programs like Fit4life, we promote a fitness culture by encouraging participation in events like Yoga sessions and marathons, fitness challenges and many more. Join us to dream big We are committed to the long-term growth and success of our employees, empowering them to envision and work towards fulfilling careers. We are dedicated to fostering the growth of our employees by offering them opportunities and resources to continually enhance and reshape their skills and careers, ensuring they stay at the forefront of cutting-edge technologies. Your path to a better future Learn to Grow Community Health & Wellbeing Inspiring Workspaces Diversity Learn to Grow Learn to Grow Community Health & Wellbeing Inspiring Workspaces Diversity Learn to Grow We encourage learning-linked growth where we equip our associates to deliver innovative solutions, by providing them with opportunities to access and learn from the vast collective experience and resources that exist within TCS. Our people put in a total of 59,000+ learning hours to acquire 12000+ competencies last year to remain at the cutting edge of change. Know more &nbsp about &nbsp Learn to Grow Community Focus In keeping with the Tata Group’s purpose-driven worldview, TCS’ vision is to empower people and communities to build self-reliance. we serve the underserved and unmet needs of people & communities - especially where the need is high, marginalization is the most, and resources are the least, often in the remotest parts of the country. Know more &nbsp about &nbsp Community Focus Health & Wellbeing We prioritize our associates' health and mental wellbeing. Holistic well-being programs within TCS promote a healthier lifestyle, offer work-life balance, and take into account emotional health. Through programs like Fit4life, we promote a fitness culture by encouraging participation in events like Yoga sessions and marathons, fitness challenges and many more. World-class Workspaces Work alongside your peers in world-class facilities at our Santiago office, a hub of innovation and collaboration in the heart of Chile. Located in downtown Santiago, this vibrant center is more than just a workplace, it's a key hub that powers TCS' IT operations and Global Process Outsourcing (BPO) services. With cutting-edge infrastructure, diverse teams and a culture of continuous learning, our Santiago office connects global expertise with local talent to deliver transformative solutions to our clients. Embrace Diversity We are an equal opportunity employer committed to making an inclusive and equitable workplace where you are welcome as you are. 40% of our workforce is comprised of women spanning 15+ nationalities. We have three generations represented with 19% of them being Gen X and 37% millennials. Join us to dream big. We are committed to the long-term growth and success of our employees, empowering them to envision and work towards fulfilling careers. We are dedicated to fostering the growth of our employees by offering them opportunities and resources to continually enhance and reshape their skills and careers, ensuring they stay at the forefront of cutting-edge technologies. Your path to a better future Learn to Grow Community Health & Wellbeing Inspiring Workspaces Diversity Learn to Grow Learn to Grow Community Health & Wellbeing Inspiring Workspaces Diversity Learn to Grow We encourage learning-linked growth where we equip our associates to deliver innovative solutions, by providing them with opportunities to access and learn from the vast collective experience and resources that exist within TCS. Our people put in a total of 45,000+ learning hours to acquire 7000+ competencies last year to remain at the cutting edge of change. Know more &nbsp about &nbsp Learn to Grow Community Focus In keeping with the Tata Group’s purpose-driven worldview, TCS’ vision is to empower people and communities to build self-reliance. we serve the underserved and unmet needs of people & communities - especially where the need is high, marginalization is the most, and resources are the least, often in the remotest parts of the country. Know more &nbsp about &nbsp Community Focus Health & Wellbeing We prioritize our associates' health and mental wellbeing. Holistic well-being programs within TCS promote a healthier lifestyle, offer work-life balance, and take into account emotional health. Through programs like Fit4life, we promote a fitness culture by encouraging participation in events like Yoga sessions and marathons, fitness challenges and many more. World-class Workspaces Work alongside your peers in world-class facilities spread across 2 offices in Bogotá and Medellin. The plush new office at Calle 26, Bogotá is located in one of the most exclusive business areas of the city. It has been designed as an agile workplace to stimulate teamwork, creativity, and innovation. In Medellín, the TCS office is located at CEOH, a large two-story headquarter that offers an outstanding work environment. Embrace Diversity We are an equal opportunity employer committed to making an inclusive and equitable workplace where you are welcome as you are. 37% of our workforce is comprised of women spanning 10+ nationalities. We have three generations represented with 61% of them being millennials. Únete a nosotros para soñar en grande. Nos comprometemos con el crecimiento y el éxito a largo plazo de nuestros empleados, empoderándolos para que visualicen y trabajen hacia carreras profesionales gratificantes. Nos dedicamos a impulsar su crecimiento, ofreciéndoles oportunidades y recursos para que mejoren y transformen continuamente sus habilidades y carreras, asegurándonos de que se mantengan a la vanguardia de la tecnología. El camino hacia un futuro mejor Aprende a crecer Enfoque en la comunidad Salud y bienestar Espacios de trabajo de primer nivel Diversidad Aprende a crecer Aprende a crecer Enfoque en la comunidad Salud y bienestar Espacios de trabajo de primer nivel Diversidad Aprende a crecer Fomentamos el crecimiento basado en el aprendizaje, capacitando a nuestros asociados para ofrecer soluciones innovadoras, brindándoles oportunidades para acceder y aprender de la vasta experiencia y los recursos colectivos que existen en TCS. Nuestro equipo dedicó más de 45,000 horas de aprendizaje el año pasado para adquirir más de 7,000 competencias y mantenerse a la vanguardia del cambio. Saber más &nbsp about &nbsp Aprende a crecer Enfoque en la comunidad En consonancia con la visión de mundo impulsada por un propósito del Grupo Tata, la visión de TCS es empoderar a las personas y las comunidades para construir su autosuficiencia. Atendemos las necesidades desatendidas y no satisfechas de las personas y las comunidades, especialmente donde la necesidad es alta, la marginación es mayor y los recursos son menores, a menudo en las partes más remotas del país. Saber más &nbsp about &nbsp Enfoque en la comunidad Salud y bienestar Priorizamos la salud y el bienestar mental de nuestros asociados. Los programas de bienestar holístico de TCS promueven un estilo de vida más saludable, ofrecen equilibrio entre la vida laboral y personal y consideran la salud emocional. A través de programas como Fit4life, promovemos una cultura del fitness al fomentar la participación en eventos como sesiones de yoga, maratones, retos de fitness y muchos más. Espacios de trabajo de primer nivel Trabaja junto a tus colegas en instalaciones de primer nivel distribuidas en tres oficinas en Bogotá y Medellín. La nueva y elegante oficina en la Calle 26 de Bogotá se encuentra en una de las zonas de negocios más exclusivas de la ciudad. Ha sido diseñada como un espacio de trabajo ágil que fomenta el trabajo en equipo, la creatividad y la innovación. En Medellín, la oficina de TCS se encuentra en CEOH, una amplia sede de dos plantas que ofrece un ambiente de trabajo excepcional. Abrazar la diversidad Somos una empresa que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades y nos comprometemos a crear un entorno laboral inclusivo y equitativo donde te sientas bienvenido tal como eres. El 37 % de nuestra plantilla está compuesta por mujeres de más de 10 nacionalidades . Tenemos tres generaciones representadas, de las cuales el 61 % son millennials. Join us to dream big. We are committed to the long-term growth and success of our employees, empowering them to envision and work towards fulfilling careers. We are dedicated to fostering the growth of our employees by offering them opportunities and resources to continually enhance and reshape their skills and careers, ensuring they stay at the forefront of cutting-edge technologies. Your path to a better future Learn to Grow Community Health & Wellbeing Inspiring Workspaces Diversity Learn to Grow Learn to Grow Community Health & Wellbeing Inspiring Workspaces Diversity Learn to Grow We encourage learning-linked growth where we equip our associates to deliver innovative solutions, by providing them with opportunities to access and learn from the vast collective experience and resources that exist within TCS. Our people put in a total of 187,000+ learning hours to acquire 38,000+ competencies last year to remain at the cutting edge of change. Know more &nbsp about &nbsp Learn to Grow Community Focus We are at the heart of driving positive change in the communities connected to us. 73,000+ beneficiaries impacted through our initiatives. 3200+ TCSers volunteered 5,000+ hours to bring in lasting positive impact to people. Know more &nbsp about &nbsp Community Focus Health & Wellbeing We prioritize our associates' health and mental wellbeing. Through programs like Fit4life, we promote a fitness culture by encouraging participation in events like Yoga sessions and marathons for a holistic future. In the past year, our Fit4lifers traversed 35,000+ kms. World-class Workspaces Work alongside your peers in world-class facilities spread across 8 offices: 3 in Guadalajara, 3 in Querétaro, 1 in México City and 1 in Monterrey. TCS Guadalajara, with over 6000 team members, is one of the biggest delivery centers outside of India. TCS Querétaro operates as a fully agile delivery center. The new Monterrey office is TCS's ninth in the country and features a modern building that ranks among the tallest in the city. Embrace Diversity We are an equal opportunity employer committed to making an inclusive and equitable workplace where you are welcome as you are. 25% of our workforce is comprised of women spanning 15+ nationalities. We have three generations represented with 69% of them being millennials. Our commitment to lead with empathy, resilience, and purpose enables us to create positive impact for our employees, customers, partners, and communities we live in. Estamos comprometidos con el crecimiento y el éxito a largo plazo de nuestros colaboradores, impulsándolos a imaginar y construir carreras profesionales significativas. Nos dedicamos a fomentar su desarrollo ofreciéndoles oportunidades y recursos que les permitan fortalecer y reinventar continuamente sus habilidades y trayectorias profesionales, asegurando que se mantengan a la vanguardia de las tecnologías más innovadoras. Para ello, les damos acceso a la amplia experiencia colectiva y a los recursos disponibles dentro de TCS. El año pasado, nuestra gente dedicó más de 187.000 horas de aprendizaje para adquirir más de 38.000 competencias, con el fin de mantenerse a la vanguardia del cambio. Conoce más &nbsp about &nbsp Aprende a crecer Enfoque en la comunidad Estamos en el centro de la generación de cambios positivos en las comunidades con las que estamos conectados. Más de 73.000 beneficiarios han sido impactados a través de nuestras iniciativas. Más de 3.200 colaboradores de TCS ofrecieron más de 5.000 horas de voluntariado, generando un impacto positivo y duradero en las personas. Conoce más &nbsp about &nbsp Enfoque en la comunidad Salud y bienestar Priorizamos la salud y el bienestar mental de nuestros colaboradores. A través de programas como Fit4Life, promovemos una cultura de bienestar, incentivando la participación en actividades como sesiones de yoga y maratones, con una visión de futuro integral. Durante el último año, nuestros Fit4Lifers recorrieron más de 35.000 km. Espacios de trabajo de primer nivel Trabaja junto a tus colegas en instalaciones de primer nivel distribuidas en 8 oficinas: 3 en Guadalajara, 3 en Querétaro, 1 en Ciudad de México y 1 en Monterrey. TCS Guadalajara, con más de 6.000 colaboradores, es uno de los centros de trabajo más grandes fuera de la India. TCS Querétaro opera como un centro de trabajo completamente ágil. La nueva oficina de Monterrey es la novena de TCS en el país y cuenta con un edificio moderno que se encuentra entre los más altos de la ciudad. Abrazar la diversidad Somos un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades, comprometido con la creación de un entorno laboral inclusivo y equitativo, donde eres bienvenido tal como eres. El 25% de nuestra fuerza laboral está conformada por mujeres, con una representación también de más de 15 nacionalidades. Además, contamos con tres generaciones dentro de nuestra organización, de las cuales el 69% es generación millennial.
