Achieve. Inspire. #WomenAtBirlasoft At Birlasoft, we are committed to providing fair opportunities to all employees, create a culture that values Diversity, Equity and Inclusion , and doesn't shy away from challenging dialogues that lead to overall understanding and progress. An important extension to our diversity thrusts also include empowering our women workforce – create opportunity for them to pursue and integrate career, personal interests and responsibilities. We also understand that having a family and a career can be a balancing act and strive to support all our staff to ensure that each person is able to reach their career's full potential, while maintaining a good work-life balance. Celebrating Anu Singh as a Woman Achiever at Birlasoft Anu Singh Strong-willed, Re-starter, Leader Birlasoft I read a beautiful line: "Even nature takes breaks, Summer, Rainy, Winter, Autumn". As mothers, we tend to prioritize our children over our careers and I decided to put a break on my high profile sales career of 8 years as a Corporate Investment Advisor. While there was no guilt about choosing a different direction, I started to feel a void as my kids grew up. That's when I reset the ignition and started working towards my professional dreams and goals of life again. It took me more than a year to find an organization willing to bet on me with my career break and no prior work experience of working in the UK. I joined an IT Services company in London as Business Consultant in Sales – a role very different from what I had experience in . It took hard work, determination and family support to create a space for myself in this new role, organization, and the industry. I pulled out all stops and it was a moment of great pride when I brought in the largest deal across my organization . It felt great to have gathered myself a second time as an ambitious woman ready to achieve newer heights and being able to balance work and life. My head is held high when my children say that they are proud of me , that I manage a whole lot at the same time. I joined Birlasoft in January 2020 and I am a part of the new business sales team in the UK. I work out of the London office and my role involves getting new logos, business and after incubation handing it over to account teams . As a learning I recommend to not stop dreaming and to be passionate. Make up your mind and come out of your comfort zone - everything is possible! Celebrating Parul Pathak as a Woman Achiever at Birlasoft Parul Pathak Education Evangelist, Mother, Combat Woman, Leader , Birlasoft The life of an ambitious small towner is challenging, baffling, exhausting, but never dull. I grew up in Saharanpur, UP – in a social structure prepared to host the groom, but ill-prepared to accept their ambitious daughters; where savings are for the girl's marriage but never for her education. It was not easy to dream and want more from life. I had my father's blessings, and my mother's unconditional love, and together we fought the prevailing gender norms. Despite advice from the elders on "what is right" and "financial priorities", I came to Delhi to study – I was adamant about it. I lost my father while I was in college, but I was determined to not give up . I was in a difficult financial situation and I worked alongside my studies. My father's "don't ever drop your education" advice powered me along. I have not looked back since. I have been proudly sponsoring education for children of all of my domestic helpers since the time I started earning. I actively mentor young women from my hometown on education and career options. The advise and support that has helped me is what I pass along. I am a Program Manager, Messaging & IT Service Delivery Leader with diverse experience. At Birlasoft I work with Corporate Operations on challenging Projects. I continue to dream and be stubborn about what I want – stubborn to keep going but never stopping. Today I am a blessed wife, a happy mother, and a combat woman who believes in spreading positivity. The #WomenSpeak... Quote She Wrote... "At Birlasoft, Being a DEI Leader I feel very proud that the work am doing is aligned to my higher purpose of making a difference in people’s life. I feel privileged to champion Diversity & Inclusion for an organization which propagates equitable environment & fosters a sense of mutual trust and respect in the workplace. We are persistently striving to ensure that people thrive in the company of each other, collaborating effectively to help the organization achieve its goals, Our DEI charter is focusing on Diverse hiring, sensitization and development of diverse talent & we are Continuously working towards breaking Unconscious biases and fostering an inclusive workplace." "Women Development program(Bempowered) is close to my heart, fostering self-awareness and work-life integration for high-performing women. Birlasoft's commitment to diversity, equality, and inclusion is truly empowering, thanks to the collective efforts of our dedicated teams. The session was quite inspirational and relatable. I could resonate with the situations that were discussed. We would definately need to have more of these sessions. The take aways of identifying taboos ,trusting and networking are very much required for women to make decisions around their Personal and Professional growth." "Joining Birlasoft has been a game-changer for me. The company's unwavering commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is not just a statement but a lived reality. Birlasoft fosters an environment where every voice matters, providing equal opportunities for growth. It's a workplace where diversity isn't just supported; it's celebrated. Proud to be part of a company driving positive change." "Anne Frank (German born diarist) has very rightly said " Everyone has inside of her a piece of good news. The good news is that you don't know how great you can be, how much you can love, what you can accomplish, and what your potential is ". I truly cherish the overwhelming support which I received from the pillars of this organization during the thick and thins of my career. I was invariably encouraged to demonstrate the potential to 'break the monotonous' and achieve plethora of successes. 'Never give up' was the primary mantra which I have wholeheartedly leveraged from this organization. Unequivocally, Birlasoft supports every individual without any bias to nurture and grow with full zeal. I am truly privileged and proud to be a part of this family! " "It has been more than 5+ years at Birlasoft and every day here brings exciting challenges; motivating me to work at my best. How much effort one puts in his/her work, has of course no limit, because sky is the limit; but I am fortunate that I have had the opportunity to work in company which provides me opportunities to liaise with people who have enriched themselves through experience in different domains. The company culture helps me balance both my professional, as well as personal life seamlessly. Thank you, Birlasoft! " "Birlasoft gave me an opportunity to be part of a great team, which has members who are not only talented and passionate about their work, but also lend a helping hand whenever you need one. The company's positive atmosphere and culture of encouraging new ideas has made it possible for me to complete 6+ years here." Load more "At Birlasoft, I've immersed myself in a culture committed to diversity equity and inclusion. Daily, I navigate diverse roles within teams, finding each challenge a learning opportunity. Despite time zone differences, Birlasoft's flexibility ensures a perfect work-life balance. It's a people-centric organization that prioritizes career growth and cross-skilling, offering the flexibility to choose one's path. The unique culture nurtures both personal and professional fulfillment, making Birlasoft an exceptional workplace." "At Birlasoft, my passion for learning and delivering my best has increased with every passing day. I have been able to achieve a perfect balance on the personal and professional front. Not only do I feel motivated but also feels good to know that my opinions are heard and valued. I feel proud to be a part of an organization which believes in their employees." "We have people from all walks of life and, this diversity in Birlasoft brings several skills and meaningful engagements, which makes interaction amonsgt people easier for me. I enjoy the respect I get from my colleagues. For me success and happiness in Birlasoft is NOT the result of the amount of time I put in at work, but the quality of time and happiness I get." "I feel grateful that I am working in a organization where I get complete support from my colleagues and I'm able to achieve a good work-life balance. At Birlasoft, I get several growth opportunities which gives me personal satisfaction. The safe and secure work environment and respectful culture in the organization, helps me give my best to every task I take in hand." "Birlasoft is truly a gender diverse and inclusive workplace. The organization has given me the opportunity to unearth my potential by giving me a role to manage a large team and mentor the newcomers without any restraint. It offers a flexible working environment where I can adjust my work schedule according to my personal needs. I can freely voice my opinions and I know they will be heard. Overall, the environment is very encouraging in bringing out the best in me!" "I feel happy working at Birlasoft. I believe that one should never get so busy making a living that you forget to make a life, and I am grateful to Birlasoft as it encourages a healthy work-life balance. Birlasoft enables me to live my life to the fullest. It's a great place to work!" Load more "I thank Birlasoft for providing me multiple opportunities to progress, and also want to thank my seniors who have guided me. I have enjoyed my tenure at the company and would like to contribute much more to the success of the brand. Best wishes to all the #WomenAtBirlasoft. It's always great fun to work here!" "At Birlasoft, I'm proud to witness a workplace where the sky's the limit for women. The success stories of our female leaders reflect a commitment to breaking glass ceilings. The organization's intrinsic value of equal treatment is evident in dedicated mentoring sessions addressing unconscious bias. Birlasoft places paramount importance on the safety and security of its employees, especially women, with zero-tolerance policies in place. The BeEmpowered—Women's Leadership Development program is close to my heart, fostering self-awareness and work-life integration for high-performing women. Birlasoft's commitment to diversity, equality, and inclusion is truly empowering, thanks to the collective efforts of our dedicated teams." "Birlasoft enables balancing of work and leisure seamlessly. To strike a balance in my personal life post-maternity, I got the flexibility to work on half-a-day basis. No wonder so many employees invest in a long career here!" "Birlasoft challenges me to continue learning, adapt to new technologies, and responsibilities; helping me evolve into a better person. Collaborating with global teams daily makes me value my colleagues for consistent support." Choose To Challenge... rows.description: Learning and Development (L&D) Experiences | Birlasoft Skip to main content Careers Resources Global | EN Brazil | PT Search Who We Are The CKA Birla Group Birlasoft Leadership What We Do AI Led Solutions Birlasoft Cogito™ PLM Regulatory Compliance SERVICES DIGITAL Home Customer Experience Data Analytics Connected Products Intelligent Automation Cloud Generative AI Enterprise Integration ENTERPRISE TECHNOLOGIES AND SERVICES Home Oracle and JD Edwards Customer Relationship Management SAP Manufacturing Execution Systems Infor Product Lifecycle Management Microsoft Supply Chain Management PTC Environmental, Social & Governance AWS IT Transformation Google Cloud Applications Management Salesforce Testing CLOUD AND INFRASTRUCTURE Home One Cloud Anywhere Workplace Service Integration Cybersecurity SOLUTIONS Birlasoft LynX intelliOpen intelliAsset TruView™ CLM TruServ FSM TruLens iLink™ Akoya Supplier Risk Radar Intelligent Document Intake Who we serve Banking Capital Markets Energy & Resources High Tech Insurance Life Sciences & Healthcare Manufacturing Media & Entertainment Utilities Company News Events and Webinars Podcasts Watch Now Webinars Media Relations Resources Awards Analyst Investors Alliances & Partnerships Sustainability Diversity, Equity & Inclusion Community Initiatives Contact Language Global | EN Brazil | PT Home Careers Learning and Development at Birlasoft Learning and Development at Birlasoft At Birlasoft, learning is a fundamental core value. We are committed to fostering a culture of continuous learning that aligns with the evolving business landscape. Our Learning and Development (L&D) Team strives to build an environment where employees are motivated to enhance their skills through structured programs. These programs encompass technology, behavioral competencies, industry-specific knowledge, and leadership development. Campus to Corporate C2C is a rigorous program designed to bridge the gap between academia and corporate work culture, helping graduates adapt to a new environment of people, policies, and values. Through this program, young graduates develop and integrate competencies in technical and project-based learning, as well as behavioral skills, all specifically tailored to foster a shift in mindset and behavior. Aadesh Jain​ "My experience with the C2C program has been transformative. The program provided valuable exposure to the IT industry, allowing me to learn new languages and enhance my communication skills. It facilitated my transition from campus to corporate life by equipping me with in-depth knowledge and insights into emerging technologies. I acquired proficiency in Java, SQL, Python, UI, and essential power skills, which have been instrumental in my career growth. Learning effective client handling was a game-changer. Representing my batch at the convocation ceremony boosted my confidence, and overall, the C2C program has enriched my foundation for success in the IT industry." Ritika Bharadwaj "The Campus to Corporate (C2C) training program has played a pivotal role in my transition from academia to the professional realm. It has notably enhanced my proficiency in work-life balance, time management, responsibility management, and professional communication skills. Additionally, the program facilitated self-awareness, enabling me to identify and leverage my strengths and address areas for improvement. It was both informative and engaging, encouraging me to expand beyond my comfort zone. I wholeheartedly endorse this program to individuals seeking a seamless transition from academic to corporate life." How Do We Upskill Our People? --> Gen AI Academy At Birlasoft, we recognize the transformative potential of generative AI. To harness this, we’ve established the Gen AI Academy, a specialized training program for all employees. This academy keeps our team updated with the latest AI knowledge and skills, fostering a culture of continuous learning and innovation. By educating our workforce in generative AI, we not only enhance our capabilities but also ensure we deliver cutting-edge solutions to our clients. The academy offers a wide range of courses for everyone in our organization, from senior executives and leadership to developers, functional users, and managers. These courses cater to different expertise levels, from foundational to expert. MySkillPath Program The Birlasoft internal certification program is a role and competency-based Learning and Development (L&D) initiative, developed in collaboration with Business Units. It offers a variety of learning curricula designed to upskill, reskill, and cross-skill our employees, aligning with their career progression. TechXchange Program Series TechXchange Program is our internal knowledge-sharing initiative where industry and business unit subject matter experts share real-time experiences and in-depth knowledge on advanced topics. This includes our proprietary solutions and tools, technical skills, updates from alliance partners, project management techniques, domain expertise, and more. Domain Capability Building In the rapidly evolving IT industry, the role of IT professionals is shifting from mere developers to strategic business partners who grasp the complexities of their clients’ business environments. This learning initiative aims to provide our employees with comprehensive domain knowledge, enabling them to become true partners with our valued clients. By understanding the client’s domain and process lifecycle, our team can align their strategies to seamlessly integrate with the client’s ecosystem. Manufacturing Life Sciences & Services BFSI Energy & Utilities Communications, Media, and Technology Leadership Development - How Do We Nurture and Grow Our Leaders? New Managers Program This program is crafted to equip new managers with the essential tools and skills necessary for leading people. It aims to provide managers with the right ecosystem, instill the mindset required for effective team leadership, and enhance communication skills to achieve success swiftly and build trusted relationships with their team. High Performing Manager Series The program is tailored for seasoned managers to skilfully enhance their people management capabilities. It fosters an environment where team members, united under a shared goal, can contribute to greater overall organizational success.​ Manager as a Coach The program aims to develop effective performance coaching skills and behaviors, with a focus on enhancing emotional intelligence, effective feedback skills, and the practical application of management coaching techniques. The goal is to enable managers to have more effective and productive conversations with their teams. Young Titans This program is designed to equip our emerging leaders and high-potential employees with the essential leadership and behavioral skills needed to excel in their careers. Parul Jain "The program challenged me to think differently and gave me the chance to learn directly from our senior leaders. I also got an opportunity to interact with our CXOs and it was incredibly enriching. Their real-world experiences, practical advice, and mentorship provided us with a deeper understanding of leadership dynamics and organizational strategy. The program wasn’t just theory - We worked on action learning projects where we were able to apply the concepts learned, in a practical setting. The program encouraged self-reflection, continuous learning, networking, self-branding, and career navigation. To sum it up, for me Young Titans was a journey of becoming a better version of myself." BEmpowered (Women’s Leadership Development Program) The program aims to strengthen the succession pipeline by grooming women leaders for more senior roles. It focuses on recognizing the natural strengths that women bring to their roles, differentiating between externally and internally imposed constraints, letting go of self-limiting behaviors, taking charge of their careers, creating a personal brand and projecting confidence through their communication and presence. PM Aspire Program PM Aspire is a career enhancement program designed to develop the desired project and program management competencies within our organization. The goal is to enable the delivery of projects with the highest quality, on time, and within budget. This program covers Project Management (PMP), Program Management (PgMP), Portfolio Management (PfMP) competencies, Leadership skills, and Birlasoft processes, tools and artefacts. PM Aspire Gold Anuj Mathur​ "The concepts and application of Mentoring were really refreshing, and I would certainly apply those in my daily interactions with the team. The Earned Value concepts were explained in detail with some very relevant examples, something I am looking forward to applying on my projects. The knowledge of the presenter at the Hands-on workshop and the way he was able to establish a connect was really appreciate and made the sessions intriguing." PM Aspire Gold Divya Thakur​ "The Coursera online content, workshops, and training sessions that were organized not only enhanced our abilities but also inspired us to strive for excellence in our roles. This journey has been enriching, equipping me with deeper insights into advanced project management methodologies and helping me to use that knowledge in my projects. In our day-to-day lives, we are managing the same process and following project management principles. But after this Gold program, we have gained more knowledge in other areas that are very critical to our projects. It was an overall good initiative by the PMAspire team." Next Step Higher Education Program An opportunity for employees to acquire Nextgen skills and reposition their career trajectories with cutting-edge learning from reputed university / institute and mentorship programs by Birlasoft’s industry experts. What's in it for you? An opportunity to acquire an industry-leading qualification and position oneself for roles in fast growth & niche competency area. Chairman's Circle The CKA Birla Group's Hi-Potential Development Program The Chairman's Circle is one of the most prestigious leadership development programs at The CKA Birla Group, sponsored by the chairpersons, and is managed by the group office. rows.title: AM/Manager– Procurement (Admin, Real Estate & HR)
rows.description:
On-roll Buyer – Admin Real Estate & HR Procurement:

Role Overview:

The Buyer – Admin, Real Estate & HR Procurement will be responsible for managing end-to-end sourcing and procurement activities across Administration, Facility Management, Lease Rentals, and HR-related categories. The role includes vendor sourcing and management, commercial negotiations, contract and lease administration, PR-to-PO processing, spend analysis, and ensuring the timely procurement of goods and services in compliance with company procurement policies.

The ideal candidate should possess strong negotiation, analytical, stakeholder management, and coordination skills, along with a service-oriented approach and a keen eye for detail.

Key Responsibilities:

Administration Procurement:
- Manage procurement of office supplies, stationery, pantry items, and other administrative requirements.
- Coordinate procurement for facility management services, including housekeeping, security, pest control, and maintenance services.
- Source and procure office infrastructure such as furniture, workstations, printers, and related equipment.
- Track and manage Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMCs), ensuring timely renewals.
- Support procurement requirements for corporate events, employee engagement initiatives, and office activities.
- Coordinate travel and accommodation bookings in line with company policies.
- Ensure timely conversion of Purchase Requisitions (PRs) into Purchase Orders (POs).
- Maintain an updated vendor database and monitor vendor performance.
- Conduct cost comparisons and negotiate commercial terms within the approved authority limits.

Lease Rental Management:
- Manage procurement support for office spaces, branches, warehouses, fleet hubs, and other leased facilities.
- Collaborate with Business, Administration, Finance, and Legal teams for new lease acquisitions, renewals, amendments, and lease closures.
- Participate in commercial negotiations with landlords, property owners, and real estate consultants to secure competitive lease terms.
- Review lease proposals and ensure compliance with procurement policies and internal approval processes.
- Coordinate lease agreement execution and maintain trackers for lease expiries, renewals, rent escalations, security deposits, lock-in periods, and notice periods.
- Process lease-related PRs, POs (where applicable), rental invoices, and payment coordination.
- Monitor rental payments, Common Area Maintenance (CAM) charges, utility-related obligations, and other lease-associated commercial commitments.
- Maintain centralized lease documentation and ensure audit readiness.
- Identify opportunities for lease cost optimization through renegotiation, benchmarking, and space utilization initiatives.
- Coordinate with internal stakeholders and external landlords to resolve commercial and operational issues related to leased properties.

HR Procurement:
- Coordinate with employee benefits vendors, including Group Medical Cover (GMC) and Group Term Life (GTL) insurance providers.
- Support onboarding and management of Training & Development partners.
- Coordinate with recruitment agencies for billing, documentation, and vendor management.
- Manage background verification vendor coordination.
- Oversee procurement of employee onboarding kits, corporate gifting, and engagement materials.
- Support coordination with payroll and HRMS service providers.
- Track contract validity, renewals, and compliance for HR-related vendors.

Operational Responsibilities:
- Ensure compliance with procurement policies, governance standards, and approval workflows.
- Prepare comparative statements, vendor evaluations, commercial assessments, and sourcing recommendations.
- Monitor procurement timelines and proactively resolve vendor-related issues.
- Maintain procurement records and documentation to support audit and compliance requirements.
- Support budget monitoring, spend analysis, and cost optimization initiatives.
- Ensure timely contract renewals and drive effective vendor performance management.

Skills & Qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, or a related discipline.
- Minimum 5 years of procurement experience, with exposure to Administration, - Facility Management, HR, and Lease Rental procurement categories.
- Strong understanding of sourcing, commercial negotiations, procurement lifecycle (PR-to-PO), contract administration, and vendor management.
- Prior experience in lease commercial negotiations and lease agreement management will be an added advantage.
- Excellent analytical and commercial evaluation capabilities.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
- Strong negotiation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
- High attention to detail with strong documentation and record management capabilities.
- Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities while delivering high-quality procurement support.

rows.title: Analytics Lead - UPI Product | Experience : 7-9 yrs
rows.description:
Full-time Employment About Paytm
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytm’s mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

About the Role
UPI is the backbone of India's digital payments revolution — and Paytm is one of its largest participants, processing hundreds of millions of transactions every month. We are looking for a Product Manager to join our UPI team and drive product strategy, user growth, and experience excellence across our UPI-powered flows.
This role sits at the intersection of consumer behaviour, financial infrastructure, and regulatory nuance. You will own high-impact product surfaces and work closely with engineering, design, data, and business teams to ship products that millions of Indians use daily.

Key Responsibilities
1. Analytics Strategy & Ownership
- Own the end-to-end analytics charter for one or more UPI surfaces — from metric definition to instrumentation to insight generation
- Build and maintain the source-of-truth framework for north-star and guardrail metrics across the UPI funnel (initiation, authentication, success/failure, retention)
- Partner with NPCI-mandated reporting requirements and ensure analytical rigor aligns with regulatory data standards
- Lead a team of analysts, setting priorities, reviewing outputs, and raising the bar on analytical craft

2. Funnel, Growth & Behavioural Insights
- Diagnose friction points across the UPI journey using deep-dive analysis, cohort studies, and funnel decomposition
- Build engagement, frequency, and top-of-wallet models to inform product and growth strategy

rows.description:
Full-time Employment About Paytm Europe
Merchants deserve better from their payments provider: fairer pricing, faster settlement, easier tools, and support from a partner that understands their business.

Paytm Europe Payments S.A., is being established in Luxembourg, backed by One97 Communications Limited, one of India's largest fintech groups, with the ambition of transforming how SMEs across Europe accept and manage payments. Following launch in Luxembourg, the business will expand into Germany, the Netherlands and other European markets. Our success will depend not only on our technology, but on building Europe's strongest merchant acquisition team.

Role Purpose
This is not a traditional recruitment role. The Commercial Talent Acquisition Manager will design, build and scale Paytm Europe's commercial recruitment capability, with a primary focus on hiring exceptional Field Sales Representatives. The role will also help establish the Paytm Sales Academy, ensuring that every recruit is assessed, onboarded, trained and developed into a high-performing merchant acquisition professional.

Key Responsibilities

Build the Recruitment Engine
- Design a scalable recruitment process capable of supporting rapid European expansion.
- Develop sustainable sourcing channels and talent pipelines.
- Build recruitment processes that deliver quality, consistency and speed.

Identify Exceptional Talent
- Target commercially driven, resilient and coachable individuals rather than traditional financial services sales profiles.
- Build relationships with colleges, universities, retail, hospitality and telecommunications sectors.

Assess Talent
- Design practical assessment processes including role plays, behavioural interviews, sales simulations and resilience testing.
- Recruit people who can sell, not simply interview well.

Develop the Paytm Sales Academy
- Create structured onboarding and training programmes covering products, payments, compliance, CRM, objection handling and merchant engagement.
- Support ongoing coaching and certification.

Employer Branding
- Position Paytm Europe as one of Europe's most exciting commercial employers.
- Develop recruitment marketing campaigns and referral initiatives.

Recruitment Analytics
- Track KPIs including time-to-hire, cost-per-hire, offer acceptance, retention and sales performance by recruitment source.
- Continuously improve recruitment using data.

Culture
- Help build a high-performance culture based on integrity, accountability, resilience and customer focus.

Ideal Background

Candidates may currently work in commercial recruitment, retail, telecommunications, FMCG, hospitality or organisations with significant field sales teams. Experience recruiting customer-facing commercial employees at scale is more valuable than experience recruiting senior executives.

Essential Experience
- Experience recruiting commercial or field-based sales teams.
- Strong interviewing and assessment capability.
- Experience designing scalable recruitment processes.
- Comfortable in a fast-growth environment.
- Excellent organisational and stakeholder management skills.
- Fluency in English and French, German and other languages are a huge plus.

Highly Desirable
- Experience creating graduate or sales academy programmes.
- Experience with assessment centres and employer branding.
- Exposure to fintech, payments, telecommunications or technology businesses.

Personal Attributes
Commercially minded, energetic, resilient and highly organised. An excellent judge of character, capable of identifying potential before experience, willing to challenge conventional recruitment practices and passionate about developing people.

Measures of Success (First 12 Months)
- Build Paytm Europe's commercial recruitment capability.
- Recruit and onboard the initial Luxembourg field sales team.
- Launch the Paytm Sales Academy.
- Develop a scalable recruitment model for Germany and the Netherlands.
- Build a strong employer brand.
- Create a repeatable recruitment engine capable of supporting long-term European growth.

Why This Role Matters
This role is central to Paytm Europe's growth strategy. Our competitive advantage will not simply be our technology, but our ability to build the strongest merchant acquisition organisation in Europe. The Commercial Talent Acquisition Manager will play a pivotal role in identifying, assessing, developing and retaining the people who will drive that ambition.

The Head of Risk will establish and lead Paytm Europe's Risk Management function across Europe. The successful candidate will design, implement and continuously enhance the Company's risk management framework, ensuring that risk management supports strategic decision-making, regulatory compliance and sustainable commercial growth. This is a foundational executive leadership role responsible for embedding a strong risk culture throughout the organisation whilst enabling innovation and business expansion.

Key Responsibilities

Build the Enterprise Risk Framework
- Design and implement Paytm Europe's Risk Management Framework, Risk Appetite Statement and supporting policies.
- Develop a consistent methodology for identifying, assessing, monitoring and reporting risks across the organisation.
- Ensure the framework remains proportionate, scalable and aligned with CSSF, EBA, DORA and other applicable European regulatory requirements.

Risk Governance
- Lead the Company's Risk function and act as the second line of defence.
- Provide independent challenge to Executive Management and business functions.
- Prepare risk reporting for Executive Management, the Board and Board Risk & Compliance Committee.

Operational & Technology Risk
- Oversee operational, technology, cyber, outsourcing, third-party and resilience risks.
- Work closely with Technology and Operations to ensure DORA and operational resilience requirements are embedded by design.
- Maintain oversight of Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery frameworks.

Commercial & Strategic Risk
- Support new products, partnerships and market expansion through proactive risk assessment.
- Provide commercially pragmatic advice that enables innovation while protecting the organisation.
- Review strategic initiatives from an enterprise risk perspective.

Risk Monitoring & Reporting
- Develop Key Risk Indicators (KRIs), risk dashboards and management reporting.
- Maintain the corporate Risk Register and oversee remediation of risk actions.
- Coordinate stress testing, scenario analysis and periodic risk assessments.

Leadership & Culture
- Build and lead a high-performing Risk function.
- Promote a strong risk culture through education, engagement and collaboration.
- Work closely with Compliance, Financial Crime, Internal Audit and all first-line business functions.

Ideal Background
The ideal candidate will have significant experience leading Risk Management within a regulated payment institution, electronic money institution, or banking environment. Experience establishing risk frameworks within a growing organisation, together with the ability to balance robust governance with commercial ambition, will be highly valued. We are seeking a builder who enjoys creating capability from first principles rather than simply maintaining an established framework.

Essential Experience
- Senior risk management experience within a regulated financial services environment.
- Strong understanding of Enterprise Risk Management, Operational Risk, IT Risk and Risk Appetite frameworks.
- Knowledge of DORA, EBA Guidelines, PSD2/PSD3 and broader European regulatory expectations.
- Experience presenting to Boards, regulators and senior executive management.
- Excellent stakeholder management and leadership capability.

rows.title: Taxation
rows.description:
Full-time Employment Manager – Taxation & Finance

Location: Mumbai, India
Experience: 4–8 Years
Qualification: Chartered Accountant (CA) Preferred

About the Role :

We are looking for a dynamic and detail-oriented professional to join our Finance team as Manager – Taxation & Finance. The role is responsible for managing the Company's direct and indirect tax compliance, tax accounting, regulatory reporting, audits, and litigation while partnering with cross-functional teams to drive finance transformation and process improvements.

The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Direct Tax, GST, tax accounting, ERP systems, and financial reporting, along with the ability to support strategic finance initiatives.

Key Responsibilities-

1. Direct & Indirect Tax Compliance
Manage end-to-end Direct Tax and GST compliance, including:
Return filing
Tax payments
Reconciliations
Statutory reporting
Ensure timely deduction, deposit, and reporting of TDS, TCS, and other applicable taxes.
Review tax implications of new products, business initiatives, contracts, and transactions.
Coordinate with tax consultants, statutory auditors, and regulatory authorities.
Support tax assessments, audits, notices, and litigation by preparing responses and maintaining documentation.
Monitor changes in tax laws and regulations and evaluate their impact on the business.

2. Tax Accounting & Financial Reporting
Ensure accurate accounting of:
Current Tax
Deferred Tax
GST
Other statutory levies
Review tax-related ledger balances and reconciliations.
Support preparation and review of financial statements from a taxation perspective.
Ensure tax provisions comply with applicable Accounting Standards, IND AS, and regulatory requirements.

3. Process Improvement & Tax Governance
Strengthen tax governance through robust SOPs, documentation, and internal controls.
Drive automation of tax compliance, reconciliations, and reporting processes.
Collaborate with ERP and Technology teams to enhance tax configurations and system capabilities.
Ensure tax-related master data and ERP configurations remain compliant with applicable regulations.
Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, accuracy, and compliance across tax processes.

4. Finance Operations & Cross-functional Support
Support month-end and year-end financial closing activities.
Participate in finance transformation, ERP implementation, automation, and process improvement initiatives.
Assist in preparation of MIS reports, management dashboards, and board or regulatory submissions.
Partner with Accounting, Treasury, Business, and Compliance teams on finance-related initiatives and projects.
Provide support on accounting, treasury, regulatory reporting, and other finance functions as required.

5. Audit & Regulatory Compliance
Support Internal Audit, Statutory Audit, Tax Audit, and regulatory inspections.
Ensure timely closure of tax and audit observations.
Maintain accurate documentation and audit trails for all tax-related transactions and compliance activities.
Ensure adherence to applicable tax laws, accounting standards, and internal governance policies.
Candidate Profile
Education
Chartered Accountant (CA) preferred
Additional qualifications in Finance or Taxation will be an advantage

Experience - 
4–8 years of relevant experience in:
Direct Tax
GST
Tax Accounting
Finance & Regulatory Compliance
- Experience in Financial Services, FinTech, Broking, NBFC, or Banking will be preferred.

The successful candidate will be expected to:

Ensure zero material tax compliance defaults or regulatory penalties.
Deliver timely and accurate Direct Tax, GST, and TDS/TCS compliance.
Successfully manage tax notices, assessments, and litigation matters.
Maintain accurate tax provisioning and reconciliations.
Ensure timely closure of audit observations and regulatory actions.
Drive automation and continuous improvement in tax processes.
Contribute effectively to finance transformation and cross-functional initiatives.

Location
Mumbai, India

Candidates based in Mumbai or willing to relocate are encouraged to apply.
reasons: Role is explicitly located in India.

We have a zero tolerance policy towards bribery, corruption, dishonesty, discrimination and internal politics. Our business solutions are designed to be inclusive and empowering for all ecosystem players. We don’t negatively disrupt our business partners’ profit pools just because we can. We set audacious goals and are not limited by incremental thinking. We take calculated risks to achieve goals and celebrate both success and failure. We will focus on quality and impact of output rather than mindless activity. We share data and learnings openly to enable better decision making across the organization. Transparency is our tool to develop decision-making muscle and ownership across the company. We work collaboratively as a team and hold the org’s goals above those of the team. We listen attentively, speak candidly, and admit mistakes. We do not tolerate politics. We believe that creating a high-trust environment is everybody’s responsibility. We are committed to creating winning teams for the long run. We do not compromise on quality of talent for short-term goals. We inspire by creating context, clarifying expectations and opening up opportunities so everyone can own their growth. We always remain open minded and willing to be influenced in search of the truth. We voice opinions even if it is uncomfortable, inconvenient or unpopular. Data is our bible for all things past, and logic is our magic wand for all things future. Our customers are our first and primary stakeholders, and we will only succeed in our vision if we create long-term value for them by building simple, reliable and value-additive solutions. We start with a holistic understanding of the problem statement before designing solutions for customers. We then create the most optimal solution possible based on first principles. We will always remain curious to explore and act on new possibilities, we learn rapidly and eagerly; and contribute effectively outside a team/function to expand our horizon. We believe in the conviction of our decisions and persevere to create sustainable value for the organization. We are not sidetracked by the flavour of the month. rows.description: Learning & Growth at PhonePe | Accelerate Your Career Company About Us Careers Press Blog Our Solutions For Businesses For Consumers Offline Merchant Solutions Offline Payments Offline Partner Program See All → Online Merchant Solutions Payment Gateway Payment Gateway Partner Payment Aggregator Payment Links See All → More Solutions Merchant Lending PhonePe Ads See All → Consumer Payments All Payment Instruments NRI Payments by PhonePe Co-Branded Credit Cards PhonePe SBI Card Credit Cards Wish Credit Card PhonePe HDFC Bank Credit Cards More Solutions Mutual Funds Gold Silver Insurance Travel & Commute Lending Consumer Lending Secured Lending Investor Relations Contact Us Trust & Safety ✕ Home Company About Us Careers Press Blog Our Solutions For Businesses Offline Merchant Solutions Offline Payments Offline Partner Program Online Merchant Solutions Payment Gateway Payment Gateway Partner Payment Aggregator Payment Links More Solutions Merchant Lending PhonePe Ads See All For Consumers Consumer Payments All Payment Instruments NRI Payments by PhonePe Co-Branded Credit Cards PhonePe SBI Card Credit Cards Wish Credit Card PhonePe HDFC Bank Credit Cards More Solutions Mutual Funds Gold Silver Insurance Travel & Commute Lending Consumer Lending Secured Lending Investor Relations Contact Us Trust & Safety Learning & Growth Life at PhonePe Learning & Growth Diversity & Inclusion Current Openings Learning & Growth Driving innovation at scale through a culture of continuous, accelerated learning Our Initiatives PhonePe University PhonePe University offers structured learning experiences—combining hands-on exposure, mentorship, and expert sessions—to support continuous growth from foundational skills to leadership readiness, helping employees stay future-ready and aligned with evolving business needs. Learning Assistance Program Empowering employees to take charge of their growth through an annual learning wallet that supports external courses, certifications, and skill development. Whether it's about deepening domain expertise or exploring new interests, LAP encourages continuous, personalized learning aligned with individual aspirations and career goals. Career Hub An internal mobility platform that enables PhonePe-rs to explore cross-functional opportunities and fulfilling career paths within the org. Employees can navigate internal moves with confidence through ‘Career Jams’ with hiring managers that offer deeper insights into internal roles. Manager Development Programs Managers accelerate career growth by helping teams build on their strengths. That’s why we invest in their development through impactful programs like New Manager Orientation, Competency Workshops, Manager Circles, Catalyst 2.0, and more. Empowering women through Speed Mentoring Connecting young female employees with experienced mentors in a fast-paced, dynamic setting. Participants have focused conversations with three senior women chosen based on their interests and career aspirations. This initial interaction allows them to discover potential long-term mentors they click with. Testimonials Here’s what our employees have to say Pratik Patil Insurance Business Over the past four years at PhonePe Insurance, I have consistently sought opportunities for growth and deeper understanding. To further my professional development, I enrolled in a Business Analytics course (curated by ISB) through PhonePe's Learning Assistance Program.I have always been passionate about problem-solving through an analytical approach, especially when working with data. The business analytics course has significantly enhanced my analytical skills and improved my ability to derive insights from data. Shyama Panda Regional Sales Manager As a sales professional, I’ve always believed that understanding data is key to unlocking new growth opportunities. With the increasing emphasis on data-driven decision-making, I realized it was time to strengthen my analytical skills to stay ahead. That’s why I decided to take up the Data Analytics Program from IIM Kozhikode. The course was essential in bridging the gap between raw data and meaningful insights. It introduced me to crucial analytics techniques and gave me hands-on experience with R software & MS Excel enabling me to analyze large datasets and understand customer behavior and market trends better. Now, I feel more equipped to make strategic, data-backed decisions that can optimize sales performance. Diana D’Souza Head Creative Team Having spent over a year at PhonePe, I found that the more I delved into understanding our app, the more I realized the importance of enhancing my product acumen. I wanted to build on my past experience in advertising and expand my skills to the app side of things. The desire to better my craft to think strategically and add value in the product space led me to pursue UX Writing at Berghs School of Communication, Sweden. The course offered a comprehensive 16-module curriculum covering interface design, research, microcopy, testing, audits, and applying UX principles to user flows. This was a transformative experience as a Creative leader, bridging the gap between the offline and online world. The course helped gain a deeper understanding of user behavior and the nuances of crafting intuitive, user-centric content. By keeping in mind user needs and motivations, I now see ideas with a dual lens of creativity combined with functionality. Learning alongside a multicultural group of peers, I gained insights into how UX design is applied worldwide and had the opportunity to work on apps from various countries through weekly projects. Overall, I’m grateful to PhonePe for supporting my growth into a more holistic leader. Jayanth Pulluri Trust & Safety The recent session on hiring essentials was extremely insightful. This helped me gain insights on the holistic approach of hiring and its larger impact on PhonePe and our candidates. It taught me how conducting a successful Interview is not only limited to the conversation with the candidate but is also about following the interview etiquettes such as time management, body language etc. As an interviewer, we all have some kind of biases about the candidate based on our past experiences which often acts as a barrier in the evaluation process. To overcome this, I can evaluate the candidate by giving hypothetical situations followed by probing questions to get a better understanding of the candidate's approach towards the problem statement. Prateek Grover Software Development Engineer I graduated in Electronics and Electrical Engineering, but as I progressed in my career as a Software Engineer, I felt the need to get a relevant degree to gain deeper knowledge in the field I am working in. I discovered an online MS in Computer Science from the Georgia Institute of Technology, which perfectly aligned with my goals. PhonePe's Learning Assistance Program not only made it possible by supporting the cost of my education but also provided a culture that empowered me to balance the rigorous demands of both work and study. One of the most beneficial contributions to my professional growth was the transition from iOS to Backend developer. This was accelerated because the course I took equipped me with a strong foundation in Operating Systems and Distributed Systems, enhancing my problem-solving abilities for backend systems. Thanks to the Learning Assistance Program and continuous support from my team, I've been able to apply this knowledge to drive meaningful progress in my role at PhonePe. This would ensure that we evaluate candidates effectively against relevant skills and qualities. Now, I feel more equipped to make strategic, data-backed decisions that can optimize sales performance. I wanted to build on my past experience in advertising and expand my skills to the app side of things. The desire to better my craft to think strategically and add value in the product space led me to pursue UX Writing at Berghs School of Communication, Sweden. The course offered a comprehensive 16-module curriculum covering interface design, research, microcopy, testing, audits, and applying UX principles to user flows. This was a transformative experience as a Creative leader, bridging the gap between the offline and online world. The course helped gain a deeper understanding of user behavior and the nuances of crafting intuitive, user-centric content. By keeping in mind user needs and motivations, I now see ideas with a dual lens of creativity combined with functionality. Learning alongside a multicultural group of peers, I gained insights into how UX design is applied worldwide and had the opportunity to work on apps from various countries through weekly projects. Overall, I’m grateful to PhonePe for supporting my growth into a more holistic leader. Jayanth Pulluri Trust & Safety The recent session on hiring essentials was extremely insightful. This helped me gain insights on the holistic approach of hiring and its larger impact on PhonePe and our candidates. It taught me how conducting a successful Interview is not only limited to the conversation with the candidate but is also about following the interview etiquettes such as time management, body language etc. As an interviewer, we all have some kind of biases about the candidate based on our past experiences which often acts as a barrier in the evaluation process. To overcome this, I can evaluate the candidate by giving hypothetical situations followed by probing questions to get a better understanding of the candidate's approach towards the problem statement. I discovered an online MS in Computer Science from the Georgia Institute of Technology, which perfectly aligned with my goals. PhonePe's Learning Assistance Program not only made it possible by supporting the cost of my education but also provided a culture that empowered me to balance the rigorous demands of both work and study. This was accelerated because the course I took equipped me with a strong foundation in Operating Systems and Distributed Systems, enhancing my problem-solving abilities for backend systems. Thanks to the Learning Assistance Program and continuous support from my team, I've been able to apply this knowledge to drive meaningful progress in my role at PhonePe. This would ensure that we evaluate candidates effectively against relevant skills and qualities. Mothers at PhonePe Program The program is designed to support expectant and new mothers to effectively manage family priorities while continuing to focus on their careers. Here are some other benefits available for the mothers at PhonePe: 1:1 counselling session by wellness partner for self and spouse Flexible working hours Infrastructure arrangements on request Eg. footrest, monitors etc. Quarterly parental workshops Partnership with KLAY Daycare to provide facilities Office conveyance allowance for 3 months Information on parenting and childcare Opportunity to connect with a buddy who is also an experienced mother to discuss day-to-day aspects of working, career post maternity and learn from experiences Testimonials Hear from the Mothers at PhonePe Ashi Agarwal Taxation As a mother at PhonePe, I’ve found a workplace that truly values, supports, and enables me to excel in my career while prioritizing my family. The program has provided invaluable support, from providing flexible work arrangements, to other comprehensive support systems tailored to my specific needs. The support from my manager and colleagues has made my return to work journey a fulfilling and supportive experience. Sweta Shaw Site Reliability Engineer I received comprehensive support for my mental and physical health, including the ability to work from home during my third trimester for a medical emergency. Throughout my leave, I remained connected with my team through regular updates, making my return to work seamless. Post-delivery, HR frequently checked on my health and sent goodies for me and my baby, reinforcing my connection to my workplace. Even now, my manager and team continue to provide unwavering support. Yogeshwari Kokane Software Engineer The Mothers program provided sufficient flexibility which allowed me to take care of my daughter and manage work. Regular team catch-ups continued even during my maternity leave, helping me feel connected to the organization. My manager and team constantly checked in to see how I was doing . We had frequent discussions about my maternity leave, my plan for returning, any organizational changes, and my career path. Dhanushree MS Quality Specialist Being a working mom comes with its challenges balancing work deadlines while rushing home to be with my little one but it’s also incredibly empowering. I’m grateful for the flexibility my managers offer, allowing me to manage shifts and work from home when needed. Returning to work after six months felt like a big step, but the trust I have in my organization has been key. Picking up the processes and coordinating with stakeholders has boosted my confidence and helped me succeed. Tessa Kallarackal Associate Director, Legal A supportive organization that has your back goes a long way in reassuring you that you’re not alone in this journey. From the buddy program and creche facility to flexibility options and more, PhonePe has truly walked the talk when it comes to helping women balance motherhood and their careers successfully. For me, the most heartwarming moment was the empathy and support of women leaders at PhonePe who offered encouragement, checked on my health, and gave me the confidence and motivation to navigate this journey of motherhood. Anubhuti Gupta Product Solution Engineer One of the most rewarding aspects of this journey has been setting a positive example for my child by showing that hard work and dedication truly matter. From long hours and tired nights to early mornings and big dreams, I’ve learned to handle it all. This phase comes with a whirlwind of emotions. The most significant feeling I have during this time is gratitude for the immeasurable support from my manager and team, which has made all the difference!. We celebrate individuality, champion allyship, and stand for a culture where everyone belongs. Testimonials Hear from the PhonePe-rs Burhanuddin Kesury Online Merchants, PHONEPE Growing up, I was a studious kid, focused on academics and unaware of what sexuality truly meant. It was only after finishing Grade 10 that I began to understand my feelings and the realization of being attracted to the same gender. At the time, this put me in a difficult space, struggling to make sense of what was right, wrong, or even legal, especially as Section 377 was only decriminalized in 2018. Like many others, I kept those feelings to myself out of fear of rejection, judgment, or harm. However, reading stories of others coming out and the strength they displayed gave me the courage to slowly accept myself. With the unwavering support of my partner and a close friend, I began to accept myself and come out to others. I feel truly grateful that my friends and eventually my family responded with nothing but love, support, and pride. While there were moments of discrimination from strangers, the unwavering support from my sister and the happiness in my parents' eyes gave me the strength to be unapologetically myself. In previous roles, I chose to stay closeted, worried that being open might affect my career. With little to no LGBTQIA+ support in those workplaces, it was hard to be my authentic self. Joining PhonePe was a turning point. From the application process itself, where there was clear acknowledgment and support for the LGBTQIA+ community, I felt a sense of inclusion I hadn't experienced before. Though I was initially hesitant, my colleagues quickly became friends, creating a safe space without judgment. I was fortunate to have a manager who empowered me to participate in organizational events and grow in every possible way. One of the most meaningful milestones in my journey at PhonePe was becoming part of the Queer & Here ERG. It gave me an opportunity to contribute actively toward building an inclusive and safe workplace for others like me. It has been incredibly fulfilling to be part of an organization that doesn't just talk about equality but lives it every day. PhonePe has left a lasting impact on my life, not just as an employer but as a place where I truly feel seen, heard, and valued - for who I am. Shreya Agarwal Engineering Team (TPM, Lending) As a lifelong avid reader, I noticed early on that the romance in books followed a very specific pattern. Since these stories were always between opposite genders, I began to think that the feelings I was developing in early teenage years weren't "normal." For a few years, I told myself it was just due to my limited exposure in an all-girls convent school. But as I grew older and found supportive friends, things became clearer. I figured I was bisexual. Later, meeting non-binary people was eye-opening; I realised my attraction isn't defined by gender. I'm drawn to a person's personality, their maturity, and their sense of liberation. Today, I'm grateful for spaces that empower people to simply be themselves. After all, love is love. My experience at PhonePe over the past year has been amazing. I joined fully focused on my career and honestly didn't expect much around LGBTQIA+ initiatives. But just three months in, I saw Pride Month celebrations on every floor. I was genuinely ecstatic. I reached out to the 'Queer & Here' ERG, and they were so welcoming. Since then, I've learned so much and look forward to encouraging others to be their authentic selves. PhonePe feels truly progressive, from gender-neutral washrooms to inclusive policies that make a real difference. Mriganko Saha QUALITY SPECIALIST Growing up in a conservative environment, I faced immense pressure to conform to traditional masculine norms, making it challenging to embrace my true identity. The constant fear of rejection and losing my family's affection made coming out seem impossible. During my teenage years, I found solace in music by artists like Ariana Grande and Nicki Minaj, connecting more with femininity while struggling to relate to my peers. Realizing that living a false life was suffocating, I decided to embrace my true self despite the risks. In college, I faced bullying and harassment but took a stand by advocating for anti-bullying measures, which eventually stopped the abuse. This experience taught me the power of using my voice and the importance of living authentically. At PhonePe, I immediately felt a sense of belonging and support, which was different from my previous workplaces. The emphasis on diversity and inclusivity during the induction ceremony boosted my confidence. The 2024 Pride event further reassured me that PhonePe is committed to creating a welcoming and supportive environment. This inclusive atmosphere has allowed me to live openly and proudly, boosting my confidence and helping me grow personally. The organization's policies, initiatives, and support systems, such as gender-neutral restrooms and regular LGBT awareness training, have significantly contributed to my sense of security and empowerment. Living authentically at PhonePe has empowered me to thrive both personally and professionally, reaffirming the transformative power of true inclusivity! MOHIT SINGH PRODUCT OPERATIONS, PHONEPE The realization that I was different from others settled in at a remarkably young age. While I tried to meet societal expectations of being a boy, I was keenly aware that I didn’t exactly fit the mold. Growing up in a conservative household intensified this feeling of isolation, making it hard to explore my true self. By seventh grade, the internet became my info-archives—a place where I could finally find the language to understand my identity. Over the next two years, I came to realize that I was gay. Initially, I feared rejection and fiercely sought ways to change this truth, but I eventually understood that there’s no such “switch”. Accepting myself was challenging, yet sharing my identity with friends and family brought immense relief. One by one, they embraced me, forming a support system that continues to strengthen me today. During college placements, I was excited to apply to PhonePe as my first choice and was thrilled to be selected. As an introvert, this role pushed me to collaborate with diverse stakeholders, fostering my personal and professional growth. Throughout my journey at PhonePe, I have encountered no homophobia; instead, I’m part of a team that is genuinely inclusive and respectful. My experience at PhonePe has been transformative. Participating in two Pride months has been a highlight, with thoughtfully organized events that create a safe and celebratory atmosphere. The combination of an inclusive culture, supportive leaders, and initiatives like insurance coverage for same-sex partners and LGBTQ employee resource groups has allowed me to thrive both professionally and personally. Looking back, I’m incredibly fortunate to have such compassionate people in my life who accepted me for who I am. For that, I’m deeply grateful. With unwavering support from my parents and early education programs, I gained the confidence to thrive, eventually entering mainstream schooling. My fascination with technology led me to pursue Computer Science Engineering at R.V. College of Engineering, where I adapted to challenges with lip-reading and hearing aids. Joining PhonePe as an SRE Engineer has been a milestone - right from an inclusive interview process to workplace accessibility features like the loop induction system, I’ve felt truly supported. Inspire Our Community. Grow Your Career with Airbnb. See Customer-Supporting jobs p:not(:last-child)]:mb-6 text-center"> At Airbnb, our community-supporting teams are the unsung heroes who step in during the moments that matter most. They are dedicated to ensuring that both guests and hosts have exceptional experiences, even when things don't go as planned. These teams are dedicated to providing 24/7, multichannel, multilingual support to our community across 191 countries, backed by world-class tools, an inclusive culture, and meaningful growth opportunities. These individuals possess a unique blend of deep empathy, sound judgment, and resilience, enabling them to tackle complex problems under pressure. When unexpected situations arise, our support teams are there to save the day—ensuring that guests feel valued and supported, while helping hosts maintain their commitment to our platform. Ultimately, our goal is to foster a community where great service leads to guest retention and encourages hosts to thrive exclusively on Airbnb. By joining our team, you will play a vital role in shaping these experiences and making a lasting impact in the lives of our community members. What to expect Training During our training you will build on your existing experience and skills— in essential areas like hospitality, communication, critical thinking, and policy —through a mix of guided learning, self-study, and hands-on experience. You’ll also learn all the workflows and tools needed for your role. Benefits We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support you. Benefits vary by country and may include health and dental insurance, retirement plans, Airbnb travel credits, education support, live and work anywhere allowances, paid time off and volunteer hours, and more. Career Growth Our employees learn and develop new skills every day through real-world experiences and problem-solving in their roles. We believe in internal mobility and are committed to helping build meaningful, long-term careers. Hear from our team members: “What I like most about my role is the opportunity to be at the forefront of innovation and contribute directly to the product development process. It’s rewarding to collaborate with cross-functional teams and see how my insights can drive improvements and lead to successful outcomes.” Oly L. Community Support Labs Specialist, Korea “I love the diversity of support that we offer. Each case differs from the next. I have the freedom to be myself with the users, building rapport, finding creative solutions to their concerns and restoring their faith in the brand and their joy and excitement about their trip.” Sharon M. Specialist, Premium Support, Ireland “I love that my role sits at the intersection of strategy, creativity, and impact. Every day brings a new challenge, and I get to collaborate with smart, driven people to solve problems that matter. Whether it’s leading initiatives, refining processes, or bringing ideas to life, I get to do work that not only grows the business—but grows me, too. It’s fast-paced, fulfilling, and I genuinely look forward to it every day.” Amrutesh G. Community Support Labs Specialist, India “I’m really excited to see how our team grows over the next couple of years, not just in size but also in impact. I think we’ve got a great foundation, and it’s going to be rewarding to build on that with new ideas, better tools, and smarter ways to support both guests and hosts.” Tiffany M. Specialist, Premium Support, Canada “This is the best place to leverage what you've learned to influence and provide feedback to a whole bunch of teams who are innovating our service and you are an important part in it.” Hemeng Z. Community Support Labs Supervisor, China Frequently Asked Questions What are the hours? p]:mb-6 " id="accordion-panel-0" role="region" aria-labelledby="accordion-button-0"> Your schedule may include work on weekends, public holidays, as well as early morning / evening shifts. Work schedules may be subject to change to ensure we provide exceptional support to our community. Is training provided? p]:mb-6 " id="accordion-panel-1" role="region" aria-labelledby="accordion-button-1"> During our training you will build essential skills—on topics like hospitality, communication, critical thinking, and policy—through a mix of guided learning, self-study, and hands-on experience. You’ll also learn all the workflows and tools needed for your role. Through a mix of guided learning (online and/or in person), self-study, and real-world applied learning, this training can span between 5 and 10 weeks, depending on your role. Airbnb’s training programs foster adaptability and excellence, equipping team members to navigate complex scenarios and uphold the trust and integrity of our global community. Whether your role is focused on supporting guests through critical on-trip challenges, enforcing policy compliance, or mitigating risks to community safety, these programs provide the tools and skills necessary to contribute to a welcoming and secure environment for all. What are the requirements? p]:mb-6 " id="accordion-panel-2" role="region" aria-labelledby="accordion-button-2"> We’re looking for individuals who are passionate about delivering outstanding service. Ideal candidates are empathetic, professional, and strong communicators—dedicated to supporting our hosts and guests with care and confidence. Depending on the role for which you’re applying, you may need experience in customer support or call center environments. Are there employee benefits? p]:mb-6 " id="accordion-panel-3" role="region" aria-labelledby="accordion-button-3"> Yes, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include: Health and dental insurance Retirement plans Airbnb travel credits Education support Lifestyle allowance Paid time off and volunteer hours Learn more about our benefits and culture: careers.airbnb.com/life-at-airbnb How do I apply? p]:mb-6 " id="accordion-panel-4" role="region" aria-labelledby="accordion-button-4"> Getting started is easy—just visit our Careers page and submit your most up-to-date resume or CV directly to the role. What can I expect from the interview process? p]:mb-6 " id="accordion-panel-5" role="region" aria-labelledby="accordion-button-5"> After reviewing your application, a recruiter will reach out to schedule a virtual interview if your experience aligns with the role. You’ll have a chance to share more about your experience and learn about the team. Successful candidates will meet with the hiring team. As permitted by local law, an offer of employment is considered conditional until successful completion of a background check. For bilingual roles, a language fluency assessment may also be required. What are our customer-supporting teams in Airbnb? p]:mb-6 " id="accordion-panel-6" role="region" aria-labelledby="accordion-button-6"> Community Support: A team who are here to help our guests and hosts with their questions and issues. Fraud & Safety Operations: A team dedicated to providing comprehensive fraud prevention and safety measures across the Airbnb community. AirCover & Insurance Operations: A team that guides and assists hosts and guests through the claims process when issues arise, helping them receive the eligible protection and coverage offered by AirCover. Payments Operations: This team plays a critical role in managing and executing complex and essential payment-related operations to ensure compliance, security, and customer experience excellence. Supply: This team enables growth of high quality supply for existing and new businesses at Airbnb. It provides services like Lead Generation, Vetting and Approvals, Merchandising, and Engagement to help grow and strengthen our Host Networks. Ready to join our team? rows.description: Account Manager - Careers at Airbnb Skip to main content Careers Life at Airbnb Job Search Connect Engineering Apprenticeship Internship Programs Contractor Roles Airbnb Customer-Supporting Roles Search Life at Airbnb Job Search Connect Engineering Apprenticeship Internship Programs Contractor Roles Airbnb Customer-Supporting Roles Account Manager London, United Kingdom Role overview Application Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way. The Community you will join: Our Supply Team is growing, and we want you to be part of it! As a Market Associate / Account Manager, you will play a crucial role in the retention, growth, and optimisation of host entrepreneurs and rising hosts in your assigned territory. These hosts are individuals who manage their own property or support owners by hosting on their behalf. You will focus on building strong relationships with these hosts, helping them optimise their listings, improve pricing strategies, and enhance their overall success on Airbnb. The difference you will make: As a Market Associate, you will be responsible for the retention and growth of long-tail Hosts in an assigned territory. You will establish and nurture business relationships with emerging professional host accounts by suggesting and supporting strategic initiatives that drive their success on Airbnb. These initiatives will include supply optimisation, pricing optimisation, host recruitment, and platform education. In addition, as these Hosts successfully grow on the platform, it will be imperative that you help them maintain best-in-class hospitality standards for an excellent guest experience. Beyond one-to-one account management responsibilities, you’ll also support Market Managers on your team to deliver one-to-many education programs, such as webinars and scaled e-mail communication. Ultimately, this team will be responsible for helping long-tail Hosts thrive on Airbnb. A typical day: Manage a book of business consisting of host entrepreneurs and rising hosts, ensuring their retention, growth, and optimisation on Airbnb. Conduct one-on-one optimisation and onboarding conversations, providing strategic recommendations on pricing, availability, and listing quality. Secure availability over high compression dates, ensuring hosts maximise their revenue potential. Educate hosts on product updates and policy changes, while channeling their feedback to internal teams. Respond to host inquiries and provide timely, high-quality support to improve their experience on the platform. Analyse performance data to identify trends and take action on opportunities that drive increased bookings and host success. Develop long-lasting relationships with hosts, ensuring they receive ongoing support tailored to their needs. Your expertise: 3+ years of experience in new sales, account management, or partner support. 2+ years of hospitality/travel industry experience (nice to have). Strong time management and prioritisation skills, with the ability to manage multiple accounts effectively. Proven experience working a book of business, driving engagement and growth through proactive account management. Highly goal-driven, with a strong bias for action and persistence in the face of challenges. Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage effectively via phone, email, and in-person. Proficiency in CRM tools, particularly working with leads and opportunities (Salesforce experience is a plus). Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging: Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. How We'll Take Care of You: Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way. The Community You'll Join The Homes team plays a key role in shaping the Airbnb stays experience. As a multidisciplinary team, we partner with Hosts to build high-quality, repeatable, commercially viable offerings that reflect our brand values. We're building something new: a dedicated Business Development function across EMEA, focused entirely on winning new professional supply for Airbnb. This isn't a role that inherits an existing book of business, it's a genuine new-business mandate, and you'll be one of the first people helping shape how we approach it. For this role, you'll be at the forefront of expanding Airbnb's professional supply base in one of Europe's most important travel markets, reporting into our Homes EMEA team under the Field Operations Manager. The Difference You'll Make You're not managing what already exists, you're building what's next. You'll hunt down new opportunities, win new business, and bring high-quality professional hosts and partners onto Airbnb for the first time. No inherited portfolio. No fixed playbook. Just a market to win, and the autonomy to figure out exactly how to win it. You'll own the full deal, sourcing, pipeline, negotiation, signature, onboarding, and shape how Airbnb approaches new supply acquisition from the ground up. What You'll Bring Genuine new-business, hunter-style sales experience, not account management A proven track record of personally sourcing, negotiating, and closing deals end-to-end Comfort operating without an established playbook, and the drive to build your own approach A self-directed, entrepreneurial mindset, you create opportunities rather than wait for them Strong commercial instinct and the ability to think strategically about a market Confidence taking full personal ownership of a deal, from first conversation to signed contract A Typical Day: Prospect and onboard new, high quality
