The group handles hundreds of issues across categories including Cancellations, Account Issues, Refunds, Payments, Reservations, Extenuating Circumstances, Booking & Listing issues, Safety & Claims. The organization is globally distributed with offices in San Francisco, Dublin, Montreal, Seattle, Singapore, Manila, Gurgaon and an extensive partner network serving all regions. The Difference You Will Make: We are looking for a seasoned Forecasting and Demand Planning Analyst on our Community Support (CS) team. This individual is responsible for demand forecasting and long-term planning across multi-channel contact center operations for our Global Operations team. This role ensures the organization has the right resources, at the right time, with the right skills to meet service level objectives while optimizing cost and productivity. The role combines planning, advanced analytics and business partnership to drive scalable, data-driven workforce decisions in a complex, fast-changing environment. A Typical Day: Demand Forecasting & Statistical Modeling Own short-term, mid-term, and long-term demand forecasting across all Global Operations teams and channels (phone, messaging, email, back-office etc.). Design, develop, and maintain statistically robust demand forecasting models using time series and machine learning techniques (e.g., exponential smoothing, ARIMA, regression-based models etc.). Perform trend, seasonality, and variance decomposition; detect structural breaks, outliers, and demand anomalies. Quantify forecast uncertainty through confidence intervals, error distributions, and bias analysis. Perform scenario modeling for peak demand periods, product launches, growth initiatives, and unplanned demand events. Continuously assess model performance using statistical accuracy metrics (MAPE, RMSE, MAE, bias etc). Establish model governance standards, including documentation, validation, back-testing, and post-mortem analysis. Research, prototype, and implement new forecasting and optimization techniques as business needs evolve. Perform scenario planning and sensitivity analysis to quantify trade-offs between service levels, cost, and utilization. Advanced Analytics In partnership with the Analytics and Data Engineering team, design and build scalable planning data pipelines, dashboards, and automate forecasting and capacity models to improve scalability, repeatability, and timeliness. Use SQL and Python to extract, transform, and analyze large-scale operational datasets to monitor forecast accuracy, capacity gaps, utilization, and operational risk. Decision Support & Stakeholder Communication Present forecast assumptions, methodologies, risks, trade-offs, and recommendations in clear, executive-ready formats and act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership and participate in demand/capacity planning discussions in cross-functional forums. Align cross-functional stakeholders (Delivery, Product, Finance, HR, and others) to embed planning outputs into execution and operational decision-making. Bachelor’s degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Operations Research, Engineering, Economics, Data Science, or a related quantitative field. Strong foundation in probability, statistics, and optimization. Hands-on experience building and validating forecasting models (time series analysis, exponential smoothing, ARIMA, regression, hypothesis testing) and capacity models (Erlang, queueing theory, service-level and utilization modeling). Strong understanding of contact center metrics (AHT, ASA, service level, shrinkage, occupancy); experience supporting large-scale, multi-site, or global contact center environments preferred. Advanced analytical skills with strong proficiency in Excel, Google Sheets, SQL, Python and data visualization tools such as Tableau. Experience with WFM tools (e.g., NICE, Verint, Aspect) or planning platforms (e.g., Anaplan) preferred. Strong business acumen with the ability to balance cost efficiency and customer experience outcomes. rows.title: AI QA Architect & Strategist @ Perficient
rows.description: AI QA Architect & Strategist @ Perficient | Simplify Jobs Overview Company Apply P Perficient Global digital consultancy delivering IT solutions AI QA Architect & Strategist Full-Time Confirmed live in the last 24 hours Unlock job analytics Simplify+ $92.1k - $202.7k /yr Expert Bachelor's United States Remote About the job Summary Full posting Requirements A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field. At least 15 years of experience in quality assurance or testing, including significant experience in test automation and modern quality assurance practices such as Agile, DevOps, and continuous integration and continuous delivery. Hands-on experience applying artificial intelligence, machine learning, or generative artificial intelligence to software quality, including test generation, code analysis, defect clustering, natural-language-processing-based testing, or large-language-model-based assistants. Strong understanding of quality assurance tools and ecosystems, with familiarity with cloud artificial-intelligence services, large language models, and machine-learning frameworks. Expertise in diagnosing business needs, engineering artificial-intelligence strategies, and presenting vision to executive leadership. Experience designing technical solutions and reference architectures that integrate artificial intelligence into quality assurance pipelines and toolchains. Experience supporting pre-sales and delivery activities, including proposals, estimations, proofs of concept, demos, and executive presentations. High-level written and verbal English communication skills. Responsibilities Continuously scan the market for emerging artificial-intelligence and machine-learning technologies, tools, and platforms relevant to quality assurance. Conduct structured competitive analyses, proofs of concept, and benchmark evaluations of artificial-intelligence-powered quality-assurance tools and frameworks. Produce comparison reports and recommendations covering technical, functional, cost, and risk considerations to guide tool selection and strategy. Track industry trends, standards, and best practices related to artificial intelligence in quality assurance. Design end-to-end artificial-intelligence-enabled quality-assurance solutions and reference architectures that integrate with clients' existing tools, pipelines, and platforms. Collaborate with quality-assurance subject-matter experts to embed artificial intelligence across testing types, including test-case generation, test data, regression optimization, nonfunctional testing, and risk-based testing. Define technical patterns, application programming interfaces, data pipelines, and integration models for using generative artificial intelligence, large language models, and traditional machine learning within quality-assurance workflows. Establish standards and guardrails for responsible, secure, and compliant use of artificial intelligence in quality assurance. Support sales and account teams in qualifying and shaping artificial-intelligence quality-assurance opportunities with existing clients and new prospects. Lead or contribute to solutioning, estimations, and request-for-proposal or request-for-information responses for artificial-intelligence-enabled quality-assurance engagements. Create and deliver business-oriented presentations and demos that articulate value, return on investment, and differentiation of artificial-intelligence quality-assurance capabilities. Provide expert guidance during delivery, supporting technical architects, quality-assurance leads, and development teams in implementing artificial-intelligence quality-assurance solutions and resolving complex technical issues. Understand business challenges, design strategic artificial-intelligence solutions, and present them to C-suite clients. Identify high-impact artificial-intelligence quality-assurance use cases across industries and technologies, prioritizing those with strong business value and feasibility. Design and build reusable use cases, accelerators, and demo environments for accounts and pursuits. Create technical and business-friendly collateral, including presentations, playbooks, one-pagers, whitepapers, blogs, and videos, to support marketing and sales campaigns. Partner with Marketing and Quality Assurance Practice Leaders to position the company as a thought leader in artificial-intelligence-driven quality assurance. Manage and grow relationships with strategic artificial-intelligence and quality-assurance tool vendors, cloud providers, and platform partners. Evaluate and recommend partnership opportunities to enhance artificial-intelligence quality-assurance offerings and go-to-market activities. Coordinate joint initiatives with partners, including co-selling, co-marketing, webinars, pilots, and training, and ensure alignment with quality-assurance practice strategy. Stay current with partner roadmaps and advocate for capabilities that support client needs. Help define the skills, roles, and competency model required for artificial-intelligence-enabled quality assurance. Work with Quality Assurance Practice Leaders to shape hiring profiles, training curricula, and certification paths related to artificial intelligence in quality assurance. Mentor quality-assurance engineers, leads, and architects on artificial-intelligence concepts, tools, and solution patterns, and help upskill teams through workshops and internal enablement sessions. Foster an internal community around artificial-intelligence quality assurance by promoting knowledge sharing, experimentation, and reuse. Act as a trusted advisor to Quality Assurance Practice Leaders, engagement leaders, and client stakeholders on the strategic adoption of artificial intelligence in quality assurance. Collaborate with quality-assurance subject-matter experts across testing domains to ensure solutions are practical, scalable, and aligned with delivery needs. Lead structured conversations with stakeholders to clarify goals, constraints, risks, and expected outcomes of artificial-intelligence initiatives. Desired Qualifications An advanced degree or relevant certifications in artificial intelligence, machine learning, cloud, or quality assurance, such as ISTQB. Experience with AI platforms and services, including cloud AI services, large language models, and machine-learning frameworks. Strong consulting ability to structure problems, perform market and technical analysis, synthesize insights, and present clear recommendations. Experience working collaboratively with Practice Leaders, architects, subject-matter experts, sales, marketing, and partners. Analytical, data-driven approach with attention to detail and focus on measurable outcomes and return on investment. Perficient is a global AI-first consultancy. Our team of strategists, designers, technologists, and engineers partners with the world’s most innovative enterprises and admired brands to deliver real business results through the transformative power of AI. As part of our AI-First strategy, we empower every employee to build AI fluency and actively engage with AI tools to drive innovation and efficiency. We break boundaries, obsess over outcomes, and shape the future for our clients. Join a company where bold ideas and brilliant minds converge to redefine what’s possible - while building a career filled with growth, balance, and purpose. The QA AI Technical Professional is a senior, hands-on leader focused on defining, building, and scaling ‑AI-enabled‑ QA capabilities across Perficient and key client accounts. This role combines deep QA and AI/ML knowledge with a strong consulting mindset to shape our AI QA strategy, design technical solutions, support sales and delivery, and drive market differentiation. The QA AI Technical Professional partners closely with QA Practice Leaders, QA SMEs (Functional, Automation, Performance, Mobile, Data/ETL, Accessibility, Security, etc.), and account teams to research emerging AI technologies, build reusable assets and accelerators, and ensure successful adoption of AI in QA practices. This role is actively engaging with clients’ programs. Required Skills & Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field; advanced degree or relevant certifications in AI/ML, cloud, or QA (ISTQB, etc.) are a plus. 15+ years of experience in QA/Testing, including significant experience in test automation and modern QA practices (Agile, DevOps, CI/CD). Hands‑on experience with AI/ML and/or GenAI applied to software quality (e.g., test generation, code analysis, defect clustering, NLP‑based testing, LLM‑based assistants). Strong understanding of QA tools and ecosystems, plus familiarity with AI platforms and services (cloud AI services, LLMs, ML frameworks). Expert at diagnosing business needs, engineering AI strategies, and selling vision to executive leadership. Demonstrated consulting mindset: able to structure problems, perform market/technical analysis, synthesize insights, and present clear recommendations. Proven ability to design technical solutions and reference architectures that integrate AI into QA pipelines and toolchains. Experience supporting pre‑sales and delivery: proposals, estimations, PoCs, demos, and executive presentations. Excellent communication and presentation skills, especially with new prospects and senior/executive stakeholders. Strong collaboration skills; comfortable working with Practice Leaders, architects, SMEs, sales, marketing, and partners. Analytical, data driven‑ approach with attention to detail and a focus on measurable outcomes and ROI. High level of English written and verbal communication skills. United States Jobs Architect Lead QA Architect Back Lead QA Architect Technology NICE Sandy , United States 1 months ago Until 10/24/2026 Save Apply now Adapt my CV to this job Job description At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you. So, what’s the role all about? At NICE, we are evolving NiCE’s flagship product suite, recognized as a Leader in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS) , delivering scalable, cloud-native solutions that power complex customer engagement and business workflows. We are looking for a Lead QA Architect to define how quality is engineered across this microservices-based platform. In this role, you will work closely with Product Management, Architects, and Engineering teams to design and implement scalable quality architecture across distributed systems. You will play a critical role in shaping how systems are built, tested, and integrated — ensuring performance, reliability, and scalability at scale. This is a highly collaborative, global role where you will partner with teams across regions to drive technical excellence and continuous improvement. How will you make an impact? Define and evolve quality architecture for new product innovations in collaboration with Product and Architecture teams Design and ensure robust integrations across microservices and systems within the NICE platform Select and implement the right patterns, frameworks, and tools , particularly within the AWS ecosystem Set technical direction end-to-end , partnering closely with engineering teams to embed quality into design and development Drive long-term improvements in system quality, scalability, and reliability Act as a technology evangelist , promoting best practices and raising the bar for engineering excellence Contribute to the adoption of AI within products and internal processes Collaborate with a global network of engineers and architects to influence platform-wide outcomes Have you got what it takes? 8+ years of experience in software engineering, quality engineering, or related roles 3+ years of experience in an architect or technical leadership capacity , defining system-level or quality architecture Strong programming experience with PHP and JavaScript Deep knowledge of AWS services , including: ECS, EKS, EC2 SQS, Kinesis, Lambda ElastiCache, RDS, Kafka Experience working with OpenSearch or similar technologies Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, automation frameworks, and quality engineering practices Expertise in microservices architecture , including: Domain-Driven Design (DDD) Clean Architecture principles Proven ability to define and influence system-wide quality and architecture decisions across distributed systems Experience working in complex integrations across multiple services or platforms Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to influence across teams and stakeholders Why Join Us? At NiCE, we don’t just connect systems—we connect people, platforms, and possibilities. In this role, you’ll be at the heart of driving product unification, governance, and go-to-market alignment across a mission-critical platform. You’ll join a team that breaks down silos and enables seamless customer experiences across our product ecosystem. If you are a strategic thinker, a collaborative leader, and passionate about delivering cross-platform value, this is your opportunity to shape the future of customer experience with NiCE. What’s in it for you? Join an ever-growing, market disrupting, global company where the teams – comprised of the best of the best – work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NiCE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate, innovative, and excited to constantly raise the bar, you may just be our next NiCEr! Enjoy NiCE-FLEX! At NiCE, we work according to the NiCE-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. Naturally, office days focus on face-to-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere. This role is located in our UT office located at 75 West Towne Ridge Parkway, Sandy, Utah 84070 https://www.nice.com/company/global-locations About NiCE NICE Ltd. (NASDAQ: NICE) software products are used by 25,000+ global businesses, including 85 of the Fortune 100 corporations, to deliver extraordinary customer experiences, fight financial crime and ensure public safety. Every day, NiCE software manages more than 120 million customer interactions and monitors 3+ billion financial transactions. Known as an innovation powerhouse that excels in AI, cloud and digital, NiCE is consistently recognized as the market leader in its domains, with over 8,500 employees across 30+ countries.
